passages.vernacular: 我認為你正直,又認為你唔正直。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我認為你正直,又認為你不正直。

passages.original: I’ll have some proof: her name, that was as fresh As Dian’s visage, is now begrim’d and black As mine own face.
passages.vernacular: 我要有啲證據:佢嘅名譽,曾像月神嘅面容一樣清新,而家被弄污,黑得像我自己嘅臉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要有些證據:她的名譽,曾像月神的面容一樣清新,現在被弄污,黑得像我自己的臉。

passages.original: If there be cords or knives, Poison or fire, or suffocating streams, I’ll not endure ’t.
passages.vernacular: 只要有繩索或刀,毒藥或火,或令人窒息嘅河流,我都唔忍受。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只要有繩索或刀,毒藥或火,或令人窒息的河流,我都不忍受。

passages.original: Would I were satisfied!
passages.vernacular: 但願我得到確定!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願我得到確定!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I see, sir, you are eaten up with passion.
passages.vernacular: 我睇,先生,您被激情吞噬喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看,先生,您被激情吞噬了。

passages.original: I do repent me that I put it to you.
passages.vernacular: 我後悔對您講咗呢件事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我後悔對您說了這件事。

passages.original: You would be satisfied?
passages.vernacular: 您想得到確證嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您想得到確證嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Would?
passages.vernacular: 想?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想?

passages.original: Nay, I will.
passages.vernacular: 唔,我一定要。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我一定要。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And may; but how?
passages.vernacular: 也可以;但點做?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也可以;但怎麼做?

passages.original: How satisfied, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 點樣確證,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎樣確證,大人?

passages.original: Would you, the supervisor, grossly gape on, Behold her topp’d?
passages.vernacular: 您作為監督者,要粗俗地瞪大眼睛睇住,睇佢被騎嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您作為監督者,要粗俗地瞪大眼睛看著,看她被騎嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Death and damnation! O!
passages.vernacular: 死亡同詛咒!啊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 死亡與詛咒!啊!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: It were a tedious difficulty, I think, To bring them to that prospect.
passages.vernacular: 我諗,要把佢哋弄到嗰種境地讓您睇到,係好麻煩困難嘅事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想,要把他們弄到那種境地讓您看到,是很麻煩困難的事。

passages.original: Damn them then, If ever mortal eyes do see them bolster More than their own! What then? How then?
passages.vernacular: 咁就詛咒佢哋,如果有凡人嘅眼睛見到佢哋共枕,除咗佢哋自己嘅眼睛!咁點樣?又點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那就詛咒他們,如果有凡人的眼睛見到他們共枕,除了他們自己的眼睛!那怎樣?又怎樣?

passages.original: What shall I say?
passages.vernacular: 我該講咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我該說什麼?

passages.original: Where’s satisfaction?
passages.vernacular: 確證喺邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確證在哪?

passages.original: It is impossible you should see this, Were they as prime as goats, as hot as monkeys, As salt as wolves in pride, and fools as gross As ignorance made drunk.
passages.vernacular: 您不可能睇見呢個,即使佢哋像山羊一樣淫蕩、像猴子一樣火熱、像發情嘅狼一樣好色,愚蠢得像被無知灌醉嘅傻瓜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您不可能看見這個,即使他們像山羊一樣淫蕩、像猴子一樣火熱、像發情的狼一樣好色,愚蠢得像被無知灌醉的傻瓜。

passages.original: But yet I say, If imputation and strong circumstances, Which lead directly to the door of truth, Will give you satisfaction, you may have’t.
passages.vernacular: 但我仍然講,如果指控同強有力嘅旁證,直接通往真相之門,能畀您確證,您可以得到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但我仍然說,如果指控和強有力的旁證,直接通往真相之門,能給您確證,您可以得到。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Give me a living reason she’s disloyal.
passages.vernacular: 畀我一個活生生嘅理由,證明佢不忠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我一個活生生的理由,證明她不忠。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I do not like the office, But sith I am enter’d in this cause so far, Prick’d to ’t by foolish honesty and love, I will go on.
passages.vernacular: 我唔鍾意呢個差事,但既然我已陷入呢件事咁深,被愚蠢嘅誠實同愛刺激住,我就繼續。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不喜歡這個差事,但既然我已陷入這件事這麼深,被愚蠢的誠實與愛刺激著,我就繼續。

passages.original: I lay with Cassio lately, And being troubled with a raging tooth, I could not sleep.
passages.vernacular: 我最近同凱西奧同瞓,因為牙痛得厲害,瞓唔著。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我最近與凱西奧同睡,因為牙痛得厲害,睡不著。

passages.original: There are a kind of men so loose of soul, That in their sleeps will mutter their affairs.
passages.vernacular: 有一類人靈魂如此鬆散,在睡夢中會喃喃自語佢哋嘅私事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有一類人靈魂如此鬆散,在睡夢中會喃喃自語他們的私事。

passages.original: One of this kind is Cassio: In sleep I heard him say, “Sweet Desdemona, Let us be wary, let us hide our loves;” And then, sir, would he gripe and wring my hand, Cry “O sweet creature!”
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧就係呢類人:我聽到佢喺睡夢中講「甜美嘅戴絲德夢娜,我哋要小心,要隱藏我哋嘅愛」;然後,先生,佢緊握並擰我嘅手,喊「啊,甜美嘅人兒!」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧就是這類人:我聽到他在睡夢中說「甜美的戴絲德夢娜,我們要小心,要隱藏我們的愛」;然後,先生,他緊握並擰我的手,喊「啊,甜美的人兒!」

passages.original: and then kiss me hard, As if he pluck’d up kisses by the roots, That grew upon my lips, then laid his leg Over my thigh, and sigh’d and kiss’d, and then Cried “Cursed fate that gave thee to the Moor!”
passages.vernacular: 然後用力吻我,好似要把長喺我嘴唇上嘅吻連根拔起,然後把腿放到我大腿上,歎息住吻,然後喊「該死嘅命運,把你畀咗摩爾人!」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然後用力吻我,好像要把長在我嘴唇上的吻連根拔起,然後把腿放到我大腿上,歎息著吻,然後喊「該死的命運,把你給了摩爾人!」

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O monstrous! monstrous!
passages.vernacular: 啊,荒唐!荒唐!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,荒唐!荒唐!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, this was but his dream.
passages.vernacular: 唔,呢個只係佢嘅夢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,這只是他的夢。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: But this denoted a foregone conclusion.
passages.vernacular: 但呢個表明咗一個既定嘅事實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但這表明了一個既定的事實。

passages.original: ’Tis a shrewd doubt, though it be but a dream.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係個尖銳嘅疑點,即使只係夢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是個尖銳的疑點,即使只是夢。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And this may help to thicken other proofs That do demonstrate thinly.
passages.vernacular: 呢個可以幫助加強其他單薄嘅證據。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這可以幫助加強其他單薄的證據。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I’ll tear her all to pieces.
passages.vernacular: 我要把佢撕成碎片。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要把她撕成碎片。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, but be wise.
passages.vernacular: 唔,要明智。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,要明智。

passages.original: Yet we see nothing done, She may be honest yet.
passages.vernacular: 我哋仲未見到任何事,佢可能仍然貞潔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們還沒見到任何事,她可能仍然貞潔。

passages.original: Tell me but this, Have you not sometimes seen a handkerchief Spotted with strawberries in your wife’s hand?
passages.vernacular: 只告訴我呢個:您有冇時常見您妻子手裡有條繡草莓花紋嘅手帕?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只告訴我這個:您有沒有時常見您妻子手裡有條繡草莓花紋的手帕?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I gave her such a one, ’twas my first gift.
passages.vernacular: 我畀過佢咁樣一條,嗰係我嘅第一份禮物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我給過她這樣一條,那是我的第一份禮物。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I know not that: but such a handkerchief (I am sure it was your wife’s) did I today See Cassio wipe his beard with.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道呢個:但咁樣一條手帕(我肯定係您妻子嘅),我今日見到凱西奧用佢擦鬍子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道這個:但這樣一條手帕(我肯定是您妻子的),我今天見到凱西奧用它擦鬍子。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: If it be that,—
passages.vernacular: 如果係嗰條——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是那條——

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: If it be that, or any that was hers, It speaks against her with the other proofs.
passages.vernacular: 如果係嗰條,或任何屬於佢嘅,佢與其他證據一齊指控佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果是那條,或任何屬於她的,它與其他證據一起指控她。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, that the slave had forty thousand lives!
passages.vernacular: 啊,但願嗰奴才有四萬條命!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,但願那奴才有四萬條命!

passages.original: One is too poor, too weak for my revenge!
passages.vernacular: 一條太少,對我嘅復仇太弱喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一條太少,對我的復仇太弱了!

passages.original: Now do I see ’tis true.
passages.vernacular: 而家我睇出呢個係真嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在我看出這是真的。

passages.original: Look here, Iago; All my fond love thus do I blow to heaven. ’Tis gone.
passages.vernacular: 睇呢度,伊阿古;我所有癡情嘅愛就咁樣吹向天空。佢消失喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看這裡,伊阿古;我所有癡情的愛就這樣吹向天空。它消失了。

passages.original: Arise, black vengeance, from thy hollow hell!
passages.vernacular: 起來,黑色嘅復仇,從你空洞嘅地獄中!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 起來,黑色的復仇,從你空洞的地獄中!

passages.original: Yield up, O love, thy crown and hearted throne To tyrannous hate!
passages.vernacular: 愛啊,把你嘅王冠同心中嘅寶座,交畀暴虐嘅恨!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 愛啊,把你的王冠和心中的寶座,交給暴虐的恨!

passages.original: Swell, bosom, with thy fraught, For ’tis of aspics’ tongues!
passages.vernacular: 胸膛啊,脹滿你嘅負載吧,因為嗰係毒蛇嘅舌頭!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 胸膛啊,脹滿你的負載吧,因為那是毒蛇的舌頭!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Yet be content.
passages.vernacular: 還係要耐心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還是要耐心。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, blood, Iago, blood!
passages.vernacular: 啊,血,伊阿古,血!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,血,伊阿古,血!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Patience, I say.
passages.vernacular: 耐心,我話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 耐心,我說。

passages.original: Your mind perhaps may change.
passages.vernacular: 您嘅心也許會改變。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您的心也許會改變。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Never, Iago.
passages.vernacular: 永不,伊阿古。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 永不,伊阿古。

passages.original: Like to the Pontic Sea, Whose icy current and compulsive course Ne’er feels retiring ebb, but keeps due on To the Propontic and the Hellespont;
passages.vernacular: 就像黑海,佢冰冷嘅水流同不可抗拒嘅航道從不感到退潮,而係一直向前,流入普羅滂提斯同赫勒斯滂海峽;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就像黑海,它冰冷的水流和不可抗拒的航道從不感到退潮,而是一直向前,流入普羅滂提斯和赫勒斯滂海峽;

passages.original: Even so my bloody thoughts, with violent pace Shall ne’er look back, ne’er ebb to humble love, Till that a capable and wide revenge Swallow them up.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅血腥思想也將咁樣,以猛烈嘅步伐永不回頭,永不退潮回到卑微嘅愛,直到一場容量廣大嘅復仇把佢哋吞冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的血腥思想也將這樣,以猛烈的步伐永不回頭,永不退潮回到卑微的愛,直到一場容量廣大的復仇把它們吞沒。

passages.original: Now by yond marble heaven, In the due reverence of a sacred vow [Kneels.]
passages.vernacular: 而家憑嗰大理石般嘅蒼天,以對神聖誓言應有嘅敬畏 [跪下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在憑那大理石般的蒼天,以對神聖誓言應有的敬畏 [跪下。]

passages.original: I here engage my words.
passages.vernacular: 我在此許下我嘅話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在此許下我的話。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do not rise yet. [Kneels.]
passages.vernacular: 先別起身。[跪下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先別起來。[跪下。]

passages.original: Witness, you ever-burning lights above, You elements that clip us round about, Witness that here Iago doth give up The execution of his wit, hands, heart, To wrong’d Othello’s service!
passages.vernacular: 作證吧,你哋天上永遠燃燒嘅光,你哋環抱我哋嘅元素,作證伊阿古在此獻出佢嘅智慧、雙手、心靈嘅運用,為受冤屈嘅奧賽羅服務!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 作證吧,你們天上永遠燃燒的光,你們環抱我們的元素,作證伊阿古在此獻出他的智慧、雙手、心靈的運用,為受冤屈的奧賽羅服務!

passages.original: Let him command, And to obey shall be in me remorse, What bloody business ever.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢下令,無論幾血腥嘅事,我都以悲憫之心服從。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓他下令,無論多血腥的事,我都以悲憫之心服從。

passages.original: [They rise.]
passages.vernacular: [二人起身。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [二人起身。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I greet thy love, Not with vain thanks, but with acceptance bounteous, And will upon the instant put thee to ’t.
passages.vernacular: 我迎接你嘅愛,唔係用空洞嘅謝意,而係慷慨接受,並即刻就要考驗你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我迎接你的愛,不是用空洞的謝意,而是慷慨接受,並馬上就要考驗你。

passages.original: Within these three days let me hear thee say That Cassio’s not alive.
passages.vernacular: 三日之內,讓我聽你講凱西奧已不在人世。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 三天之內,讓我聽你說凱西奧已不在人世。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: My friend is dead.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅朋友死咗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的朋友死了。

passages.original: ’Tis done at your request.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係照你嘅要求辦嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是照你的要求辦的。

passages.original: But let her live.
passages.vernacular: 但讓佢活著。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但讓她活著。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Damn her, lewd minx!
passages.vernacular: 詛咒佢,呢個淫蕩嘅賤人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 詛咒她,這個淫蕩的賤人!

passages.original: O, damn her, damn her!
passages.vernacular: 啊,詛咒佢,詛咒佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,詛咒她,詛咒她!

passages.original: Come, go with me apart, I will withdraw To furnish me with some swift means of death For the fair devil.
passages.vernacular: 來,跟我到一旁,我要退下,為呢個美麗嘅魔鬼準備一些迅速嘅死亡手段。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,跟我到一旁,我要退下,為這個美麗的魔鬼準備一些迅速的死亡手段。

passages.original: Now art thou my lieutenant.
passages.vernacular: 而家你係我嘅副官。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在你是我的副官。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am your own for ever.
passages.vernacular: 我永遠屬於您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我永遠屬於您。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene IV — Cyprus. Before the Castle 第三幕第四場:塞浦路斯城堡前

passages.original: Enter Desdemona, Emilia and Clown.
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞同小丑上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞和小丑上。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Do you know, sirrah, where Lieutenant Cassio lies?
passages.vernacular: 細路,你知唔知凱西奧副官住喺邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 小子,你知道凱西奧副官住在哪嗎?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: I dare not say he lies anywhere.
passages.vernacular: 我唔敢講佢「住」(lie,兼有「撒謊」之意)喺任何地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不敢說他「住」(lie,兼有「撒謊」之意)在任何地方。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why, man?
passages.vernacular: 點解,老兄?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼,老兄?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: He’s a soldier; and for one to say a soldier lies is stabbing.
passages.vernacular: 佢係軍人;講一個軍人「撒謊」,就等於捅佢一刀。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他是軍人;說一個軍人「撒謊」,就等於捅他一刀。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Go to.
passages.vernacular: 得啦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了。

passages.original: Where lodges he?
passages.vernacular: 佢住喺邊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他住在哪?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: To tell you where he lodges is to tell you where I lie.
passages.vernacular: 要告訴你佢住喺邊,就等於告訴你我「撒謊」喺邊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要告訴你他住在哪,就等於告訴你我「撒謊」在哪。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Can anything be made of this?
passages.vernacular: 呢啲嘢有咩可理解嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些話有什麼可理解的嗎?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: I know not where he lodges; and for me to devise a lodging, and say he lies here, or he lies there, were to lie in mine own throat.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知佢住喺邊;而我若自己編一個住處,話佢住呢度或住嗰度,就係喺我自己喉嚨裡撒謊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道他住在哪;而我若自己編一個住處,說他住這裡或住那裡,就是在我自己喉嚨裡撒謊。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Can you inquire him out, and be edified by report?
passages.vernacular: 你可以打聽出佢,聽報告得到明白嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你可以打聽出他,聽報告得到明白嗎?

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: I will catechize the world for him, that is, make questions and by them answer.
passages.vernacular: 我會為佢盤問全世界,即係發問,憑問題得到答案。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會為他盤問全世界,即是發問,憑問題得到答案。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Seek him, bid him come hither.
passages.vernacular: 去搵佢,叫佢嚟呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去找他,叫他來這裡。

passages.original: Tell him I have moved my lord on his behalf, and hope all will be well.
passages.vernacular: 告訴佢我已為佢向我丈夫求情,希望一切順利。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 告訴他我已為他向我丈夫求情,希望一切順利。

passages.title: Clown 小丑
passages.original: To do this is within the compass of man’s wit, and therefore I will attempt the doing it.
passages.vernacular: 做呢件事在人類智慧範圍之內,所以我會嘗試去做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 做這件事在人類智慧範圍之內,所以我會嘗試去做。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Where should I lose that handkerchief, Emilia?
passages.vernacular: 我應該喺邊度弄丟嗰條手帕,愛米利亞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我應該在哪裡弄丟那條手帕,愛米利亞?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I know not, madam.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道,夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Believe me, I had rather have lost my purse Full of crusadoes.
passages.vernacular: 相信我,我寧願丟失一個裝滿十字軍金幣嘅錢包。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 相信我,我寧願丟失一個裝滿十字軍金幣的錢包。

passages.original: And but my noble Moor Is true of mind and made of no such baseness As jealous creatures are, it were enough To put him to ill thinking.
passages.vernacular: 而若唔係我高貴嘅摩爾人心地真誠,唔係好似善妒嘅人嗰樣卑劣,呢個足以令佢起壞念頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而若不是我高貴的摩爾人心地真誠,不是像善妒的人那樣卑劣,這足以讓他起壞念頭。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Is he not jealous?
passages.vernacular: 佢唔善妒嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不善妒嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Who, he?
passages.vernacular: 誰,佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰,他?

passages.original: I think the sun where he was born Drew all such humours from him.
passages.vernacular: 我諗佢出生地嘅太陽,已把所有呢類脾性從佢身上吸走喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想他出生地的太陽,已把所有這類脾性從他身上吸走了。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Look, where he comes.
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢來喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,他來了。

passages.original: Enter Othello.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅上。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will not leave him now till Cassio Be call’d to him.
passages.vernacular: 我而家唔會離開佢,直到凱西奧被召到佢面前。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我現在不會離開他,直到凱西奧被召到他面前。

passages.original: How is’t with you, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 你點樣,我嘅大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎樣,我的大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Well, my good lady. [Aside.]
passages.vernacular: 好,我嘅好夫人。[旁白。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我的好夫人。[旁白。]

passages.original: O, hardness to dissemble!
passages.vernacular: 啊,掩飾幾咁艱難!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,掩飾多麼艱難!

passages.original: How do you, Desdemona?
passages.vernacular: 你點樣,戴絲德夢娜?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎樣,戴絲德夢娜?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Well, my good lord.
passages.vernacular: 好,我嘅好大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我的好大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Give me your hand.
passages.vernacular: 把手畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把手給我。

passages.original: This hand is moist, my lady.
passages.vernacular: 呢隻手係濕嘅,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這隻手是濕的,夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It yet hath felt no age nor known no sorrow.
passages.vernacular: 佢仲未感受過衰老,也冇知曉過悲傷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它還沒感受過衰老,也沒知曉過悲傷。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: This argues fruitfulness and liberal heart.
passages.vernacular: 呢個表明豐饒同慷慨嘅心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這表明豐饒和慷慨的心。

passages.original: Hot, hot, and moist.
passages.vernacular: 熱,熱,而且濕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 熱,熱,而且濕。

passages.original: This hand of yours requires A sequester from liberty, fasting and prayer, Much castigation, exercise devout;
passages.vernacular: 你呢隻手需要隔絕自由,需要齋戒同祈禱,許多鞭責,虔誠嘅修行;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這隻手需要隔絕自由,需要齋戒和祈禱,許多鞭責,虔誠的修行;

passages.original: For here’s a young and sweating devil here That commonly rebels.
passages.vernacular: 因為呢度有個年輕、出汗嘅魔鬼,常常造反。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為這裡有個年輕、出汗的魔鬼,常常造反。

passages.original: ’Tis a good hand, A frank one.
passages.vernacular: 呢係隻好手,一隻坦率嘅手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是隻好手,一隻坦率的手。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: You may indeed say so, For ’twas that hand that gave away my heart.
passages.vernacular: 你確實可以咁講,因為正正係嗰隻手交出咗我嘅心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你確實可以這樣說,因為正是那隻手交出了我的心。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: A liberal hand.
passages.vernacular: 一隻慷慨嘅手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一隻慷慨的手。

passages.original: The hearts of old gave hands, But our new heraldry is hands, not hearts.
passages.vernacular: 古時候心畀手,但我哋新嘅紋章學係手,唔係心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 古時候心給手,但我們新的紋章學是手,不是心。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I cannot speak of this.
passages.vernacular: 我講唔到呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說不了這個。

passages.original: Come now, your promise.
passages.vernacular: 來吧,你嘅承諾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來吧,你的承諾。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What promise, chuck?
passages.vernacular: 咩承諾,小雞?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼承諾,小雞?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have sent to bid Cassio come speak with you.
passages.vernacular: 我已派人請凱西奧嚟同你講嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已派人請凱西奧來與你說話。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I have a salt and sorry rheum offends me.
passages.vernacular: 我有咸澀可惡嘅鼻水困擾我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我有咸澀可惡的鼻水困擾我。

passages.original: Lend me thy handkerchief.
passages.vernacular: 把你嘅手帕借畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把你的手帕借給我。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Here, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 畀,我嘅大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給,我的大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That which I gave you.
passages.vernacular: 我畀你嗰條。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我給你的那條。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have it not about me.
passages.vernacular: 我身上冇帶。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我身上沒帶。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Not?
passages.vernacular: 冇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, faith, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 冇,講真嘅,我嘅大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有,說真的,我的大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That is a fault.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係過失。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是過失。

passages.original: That handkerchief Did an Egyptian to my mother give.
passages.vernacular: 嗰條手帕,係一個埃及人送畀我母親嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那條手帕,是一個埃及人送給我母親的。

passages.original: She was a charmer, and could almost read The thoughts of people.
passages.vernacular: 佢係個術士,幾乎能讀人嘅思想。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她是個術士,幾乎能讀人的思想。

passages.original: She told her, while she kept it, ’Twould make her amiable and subdue my father Entirely to her love.
passages.vernacular: 佢告訴我母親,只要佢保存住,就會令佢可愛,並令我父親完全屬於佢嘅愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她告訴我母親,只要她保存著,就會令她可愛,並使我父親完全屬於她的愛。

passages.original: But if she lost it, Or made a gift of it, my father’s eye Should hold her loathed, and his spirits should hunt After new fancies:
passages.vernacular: 但如果佢丟咗,或送人,我父親嘅眼睛就會視佢為可憎,佢嘅心會去追逐新嘅幻想:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但如果她丟了,或送人,我父親的眼睛就會視她為可憎,他的心會去追逐新的幻想:

passages.original: she, dying, gave it me, And bid me, when my fate would have me wive, To give it her.
passages.vernacular: 佢臨死時把佢畀咗我,吩咐我,當我嘅命運要我娶妻時,把佢畀佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她臨死時把它給了我,吩咐我,當我的命運要我娶妻時,把它給她。

passages.original: I did so; and take heed on’t, Make it a darling like your precious eye.
passages.vernacular: 我照做喇;你要留意:把佢當作你珍貴眼睛般嘅寶貝。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我照做了;你要留意:把它當作你珍貴眼睛般的寶貝。

passages.original: To lose’t or give’t away were such perdition As nothing else could match.
passages.vernacular: 丟失或送人,會係任何別嘅事都比唔上嘅毀滅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 丟失或送人,會是任何別的事都比不上的毀滅。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Is’t possible?
passages.vernacular: 有可能嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有可能嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: ’Tis true.
passages.vernacular: 千真萬確。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 千真萬確。

passages.original: There’s magic in the web of it.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅織物裡有魔法。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它的織物裡有魔法。

passages.original: A sibyl, that had number’d in the world The sun to course two hundred compasses, In her prophetic fury sew’d the work;
passages.vernacular: 一位在世上已見太陽運行兩百圈嘅女先知,在預言嘅狂熱中縫製咗呢件作品;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一位在世上已見太陽運行兩百圈的女先知,在預言的狂熱中縫製了這件作品;

passages.original: The worms were hallow’d that did breed the silk, And it was dyed in mummy, which the skillful Conserv’d of maiden’s hearts.
passages.vernacular: 吐絲嘅蠶係被祝聖過嘅,佢係用木乃伊染成嘅,木乃伊係巧匠從處女嘅心中保存嚟嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 吐絲的蠶是被祝聖過的,它是用木乃伊染成的,木乃伊是巧匠從處女的心中保存來的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Indeed? Is’t true?
passages.vernacular: 真嘅?係真嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的?是真的嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Most veritable, therefore look to ’t well.
passages.vernacular: 千真萬確,所以要好好留意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 千真萬確,所以要好好留意。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Then would to God that I had never seen ’t!
passages.vernacular: 咁我寧願上帝令我從未見過佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那我寧願上帝讓我從未見過它!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ha? wherefore?
passages.vernacular: 哈?點解?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈?為什麼?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why do you speak so startingly and rash?
passages.vernacular: 你點解講嘢咁突然急躁?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為何說話這麼突然急躁?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Is’t lost? is’t gone?
passages.vernacular: 丟咗嗎?走咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 丟了嗎?走了嗎?

passages.original: speak, is it out of the way?
passages.vernacular: 講,係咪唔見咗?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說,是不是不見了?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Heaven bless us!
passages.vernacular: 上天保佑我哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天保佑我們!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Say you?
passages.vernacular: 你講咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說什麼?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It is not lost, but what and if it were?
passages.vernacular: 冇丟,但如果丟咗呢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有丟,但如果丟了呢?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: How?
passages.vernacular: 點?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I say it is not lost.
passages.vernacular: 我話冇丟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說沒有丟。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Fetch’t, let me see ’t.
passages.vernacular: 去拎嚟,畀我睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去拿來,讓我看。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why, so I can, sir, but I will not now.
passages.vernacular: 咦,我可以,先生,但而家唔拎。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,我可以,先生,但現在不拿。

passages.original: This is a trick to put me from my suit.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係把戲,要令我放棄我嘅請求。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是把戲,要讓我放棄我的請求。

passages.original: Pray you, let Cassio be receiv’d again.
passages.vernacular: 請你,讓凱西奧重新被接納。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,讓凱西奧重新被接納。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Fetch me the handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 去拎手帕嚟!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去拿手帕來!

passages.original: My mind misgives.
passages.vernacular: 我心裡唔安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我心裡不安。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Come, come.
passages.vernacular: 得啦,得啦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了,得了。

passages.original: You’ll never meet a more sufficient man.
passages.vernacular: 你再也遇唔到更勝任嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你再也遇不到更勝任的人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手帕!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I pray, talk me of Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 請你,同我傾傾凱西奧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,跟我談談凱西奧。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手帕!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: A man that all his time Hath founded his good fortunes on your love, Shar’d dangers with you,—
passages.vernacular: 一個一生都把好運建立在你嘅愛之上、與你共擔危險嘅人——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個一生都把好運建立在你的愛之上、與你共擔危險的人——

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手帕!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: In sooth, you are to blame.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,你唔對。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,你不對。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Away!
passages.vernacular: 走開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走開!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Is not this man jealous?
passages.vernacular: 呢個人唔係在嫉妒嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個人不是在嫉妒嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I ne’er saw this before.
passages.vernacular: 我以前從未見過咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我以前從未見過這樣。

passages.original: Sure there’s some wonder in this handkerchief, I am most unhappy in the loss of it.
passages.vernacular: 呢條手帕裡肯定有咩奇妙,丟失佢令我極其不幸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這條手帕裡肯定有什麼奇妙,丟失它令我極其不幸。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: ’Tis not a year or two shows us a man: They are all but stomachs and we all but food;
passages.vernacular: 一兩年睇唔出一個男人:佢哋全係胃,我哋全係食物;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一兩年看不出一個男人:他們全是胃,我們全是食物;

passages.original: They eat us hungerly, and when they are full, They belch us.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋飢餓地食我哋,食飽喇,就把我哋打嗝吐出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們飢餓地吃我們,吃飽了,就把我們打嗝吐出來。

passages.original: Enter Cassio and Iago.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧同伊阿古上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧和伊阿古上。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Look you, Cassio and my husband.
passages.vernacular: 睇,凱西奧同我丈夫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,凱西奧和我丈夫。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: There is no other way; ’tis she must do ’t, And, lo, the happiness!
passages.vernacular: 冇別嘅路;必須由佢做,睇,真係幸運!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有別的路;必須由她做,看,真是幸運!

passages.original: Go and importune her.
passages.vernacular: 去纏住佢吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去纏著她吧。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: How now, good Cassio, what’s the news with you?
passages.vernacular: 點樣喇,好凱西奧,有咩消息?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,好凱西奧,有什麼消息?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Madam, my former suit: I do beseech you That by your virtuous means I may again Exist, and be a member of his love, Whom I, with all the office of my heart, Entirely honour.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,仲係我以前嘅請求:我懇求你,憑你賢德嘅幫助,讓我重新存在,成為佢嘅愛嘅一員,我以我心嘅全部職責完全尊敬佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,還是我以前的請求:我懇求你,憑你賢德的幫助,讓我重新存在,成為他的愛的一員,我以我心的全部職責完全尊敬他。

passages.original: I would not be delay’d.
passages.vernacular: 我唔想被拖延。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不想被拖延。

passages.original: If my offence be of such mortal kind That nor my service past, nor present sorrows, Nor purpos’d merit in futurity, Can ransom me into his love again, But to know so must be my benefit;
passages.vernacular: 如果我嘅冒犯係如此致命,以致我過去嘅服務、而家嘅悲傷、將來計劃立嘅功,都唔能把我贖返佢嘅愛,咁至少讓我知道呢點,也係我嘅好處;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我的冒犯是如此致命,以致我過去的服務、現在的悲傷、將來計劃立的功,都不能把我贖回他的愛,那麼至少讓我知道這點,也是我的好處;

passages.original: So shall I clothe me in a forc’d content, And shut myself up in some other course To fortune’s alms.
passages.vernacular: 咁樣我可以披上被迫嘅滿足,把自己關進另一條路,靠命運嘅施捨。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣我可以披上被迫的滿足,把自己關進另一條路,靠命運的施捨。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas, thrice-gentle Cassio, My advocation is not now in tune;
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,三倍溫柔嘅凱西奧,我嘅辯護而家唔合時宜;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,三倍溫柔的凱西奧,我的辯護現在不合時宜;

passages.original: My lord is not my lord; nor should I know him Were he in favour as in humour alter’d.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅大人唔係我嘅大人;即使佢嘅面貌像佢嘅脾氣一樣變咗,我也認唔出佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的大人不是我的大人;即使他的面貌像他的脾氣一樣變了,我也認不出他。

passages.original: So help me every spirit sanctified, As I have spoken for you all my best, And stood within the blank of his displeasure For my free speech!
passages.vernacular: 願每一位聖靈幫助我,我已盡我所能為你講嘢,並因我坦率嘅言辭,企喺佢不悅嘅靶心之內!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願每一位聖靈幫助我,我已盡我所能為你說話,並因我坦率的言辭,站在他不悅的靶心之內!

passages.original: You must awhile be patient.
passages.vernacular: 你必須耐心等一會兒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你必須耐心等一會兒。

passages.original: What I can do I will; and more I will Than for myself I dare.
passages.vernacular: 我能做嘅我會做;我會做嘅比我敢為自己做嘅更多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我能做的我會做;我會做的比我敢為自己做的更多。

passages.original: Let that suffice you.
passages.vernacular: 讓呢個足夠你吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓這足夠你吧。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Is my lord angry?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅大人生氣了嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的大人生氣了嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: He went hence but now, And certainly in strange unquietness.
passages.vernacular: 佢剛才離開呢度,而且肯定處於奇異嘅不安中。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他剛才離開這裡,而且肯定處於奇異的不安中。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Can he be angry?
passages.vernacular: 佢會生氣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他會生氣嗎?

passages.original: I have seen the cannon, When it hath blown his ranks into the air And, like the devil, from his very arm Puff’d his own brother, and can he be angry?
passages.vernacular: 我見過大炮,當佢把佢嘅隊伍吹上空中,並好似魔鬼般,把佢自己嘅兄弟從佢嘅手臂旁炸飛,佢也會生氣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我見過大炮,當它把他的隊伍吹上空中,並像魔鬼般,把他自己的兄弟從他的手臂旁炸飛,他也會生氣嗎?

passages.original: Something of moment then.
passages.vernacular: 咁一定係咩重要嘅事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那一定是什麼重要的事。

passages.original: I will go meet him.
passages.vernacular: 我去搵佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我去找他。

passages.original: There’s matter in’t indeed if he be angry.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢生氣,確實有事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他生氣,確實有事。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I prithee do so.
passages.vernacular: 請你去吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你去吧。

passages.original: [Exit Iago.]
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古下。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Something sure of state, Either from Venice, or some unhatch’d practice Made demonstrable here in Cyprus to him, Hath puddled his clear spirit, and in such cases Men’s natures wrangle with inferior things, Though great ones are their object.
passages.vernacular: 一定係咩國家大事,或者來自威尼斯,或者喺塞浦路斯向佢顯露嘅咩尚未孵化嘅陰謀,攪渾咗佢清澈嘅精神,呢種情況下,人嘅本性會與小事爭吵,即使佢哋嘅對象係大事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一定是什麼國家大事,或者來自威尼斯,或者在塞浦路斯向他顯露的什麼尚未孵化的陰謀,攪渾了他清澈的精神,這種情況下,人的本性會與小事爭吵,即使他們的對象是大事。

passages.original: ’Tis even so.
passages.vernacular: 確實如此。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實如此。

passages.original: For let our finger ache, and it indues Our other healthful members even to that sense Of pain.
passages.vernacular: 因為只要我哋嘅手指痛,就會令其他健康嘅肢體也感到嗰種痛楚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為只要我們的手指疼,就會讓其他健康的肢體也感到那種疼痛。

passages.original: Nay, we must think men are not gods, Nor of them look for such observancy As fits the bridal.
passages.vernacular: 唔,我哋必須想到男人唔係神,也唔能期望佢哋像新郎嗰樣始終殷勤。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我們必須想到男人不是神,也不能期望他們像新郎那樣始終殷勤。

passages.original: Beshrew me much, Emilia, I was (unhandsome warrior as I am) Arraigning his unkindness with my soul;
passages.vernacular: 愛米利亞,我真該罵自己,我(作為不體面嘅戰士)曾在心裡審判佢嘅無情;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 愛米利亞,我真該罵自己,我(作為不體面的戰士)曾在心裡審判他的無情;

passages.original: But now I find I had suborn’d the witness, And he’s indicted falsely.
passages.vernacular: 但而家我發現我收買咗證人,佢係被冤枉指控嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但現在我發現我收買了證人,他是被冤枉指控的。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Pray heaven it be state matters, as you think, And no conception nor no jealous toy Concerning you.
passages.vernacular: 求上天保佑嗰係國家大事,如你所諗,而唔係咩關於你嘅猜想或嫉妒嘅小念頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 求上天保佑那是國家大事,如你所想,而不是什麼關於你的猜想或嫉妒的小念頭。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas the day, I never gave him cause!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我從未畀佢理由!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我從未給他理由!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: But jealous souls will not be answer’d so; They are not ever jealous for the cause, But jealous for they are jealous:
passages.vernacular: 但嫉妒嘅人唔會咁樣被回答;佢哋並非總為咗原因而嫉妒,而係因為嫉妒而嫉妒:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但嫉妒的人不會這樣被回答;他們並非總為了原因而嫉妒,而是因為嫉妒而嫉妒:

passages.original: ’tis a monster Begot upon itself, born on itself.
passages.vernacular: 佢係一個自己生自己、自己誕生於自己嘅怪物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它是一個自己生自己、自己誕生於自己的怪物。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Heaven keep that monster from Othello’s mind!
passages.vernacular: 願上天令呢個怪物遠離奧賽羅嘅心!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願上天讓這個怪物遠離奧賽羅的心!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Lady, amen.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,阿們。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,阿們。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will go seek him.
passages.vernacular: 我去搵佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我去找他。

passages.original: Cassio, walk hereabout: If I do find him fit, I’ll move your suit, And seek to effect it to my uttermost.
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧,你喺呢附近行下:如果我發現佢心情合適,我就為你嘅請求進言,並盡力促成。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧,你在這附近走走:如果我發現他心情合適,我就為你的請求進言,並盡力促成。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I humbly thank your ladyship.
passages.vernacular: 我謙卑地感謝夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我謙卑地感謝夫人。

passages.original: [Exeunt Desdemona and Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜同愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜和愛米利亞下。]

passages.original: Enter Bianca.
passages.vernacular: [比安卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [比安卡上。]

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Save you, friend Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 向你問安,朋友凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向你問安,朋友凱西奧!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: What make you from home?
passages.vernacular: 你離家出嚟做咩?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你離家出來做什麼?

passages.original: How is it with you, my most fair Bianca?
passages.vernacular: 你點樣,我最美麗嘅比安卡?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你好嗎,我最美麗的比安卡?

passages.original: I’ faith, sweet love, I was coming to your house.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,甜愛人,我正要去你家。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,甜愛人,我正要去你家。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: And I was going to your lodging, Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 我也正要去你嘅住處,凱西奧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也正要去你的住處,凱西奧。

passages.original: What, keep a week away?
passages.vernacular: 咩,離開一個星期?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,離開一個星期?

passages.original: Seven days and nights?
passages.vernacular: 七日七夜?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 七日七夜?

passages.original: Eight score eight hours, and lovers’ absent hours, More tedious than the dial eight score times?
passages.vernacular: 一百六十八個鐘,情人不在嘅時辰,比鐘面長一百六十倍嘅煩悶?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一百六十八小時,情人不在的時辰,比鐘面長一百六十倍的煩悶?

passages.original: O weary reckoning!
passages.vernacular: 啊,疲憊嘅計算!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,疲憊的計算!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Pardon me, Bianca.
passages.vernacular: 原諒我,比安卡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 原諒我,比安卡。

passages.original: I have this while with leaden thoughts been press’d, But I shall in a more continuate time Strike off this score of absence.
passages.vernacular: 我呢陣子被沉重嘅思緒壓住,但我會喺更連續嘅時間裡,把呢筆缺席嘅帳還清。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我這陣子被沉重的思緒壓著,但我會在更連續的時間裡,把這筆缺席的帳還清。

passages.original: Sweet Bianca,
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅比安卡,
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的比安卡,

passages.original: [Giving her Desdemona’s handkerchief.]
passages.vernacular: [把戴絲德夢娜嘅手帕遞畀佢。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [把戴絲德夢娜的手帕遞給她。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Take me this work out.
passages.vernacular: 幫我把呢個花樣描低。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 幫我把這花樣描下來。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: O Cassio, whence came this?
passages.vernacular: 啊凱西奧,呢個從邊度嚟?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊凱西奧,這從哪來的?

passages.original: This is some token from a newer friend.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係新朋友畀嘅信物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是新朋友給的信物。

passages.original: To the felt absence now I feel a cause.
passages.vernacular: 對於我感覺到嘅缺席,而家我感覺到咗原因。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對於我感覺到的缺席,現在我感覺到了原因。

passages.original: Is’t come to this? Well, well.
passages.vernacular: 到咗咁地步嗎?好,好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 到了這地步嗎?好,好。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Go to, woman!
passages.vernacular: 得啦,女人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了,女人!

passages.original: Throw your vile guesses in the devil’s teeth, From whence you have them.
passages.vernacular: 把你嗰啲卑劣嘅猜想,掟返落魔鬼嘴裡,你就係從嗰度得來嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把你那些卑劣的猜想,扔回魔鬼嘴裡,你就是從那裡得來的。

passages.original: You are jealous now That this is from some mistress, some remembrance.
passages.vernacular: 你而家嫉妒,以為呢個係邊個情婦畀嘅紀念品。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你現在嫉妒,以為這是哪個情婦給的紀念品。

passages.original: No, in good troth, Bianca.
passages.vernacular: 唔,講真嘅,比安卡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,說真的,比安卡。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Why, whose is it?
passages.vernacular: 咦,嗰係誰嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,那是誰的?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I know not neither.
passages.vernacular: 我也唔知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不知道。

passages.original: I found it in my chamber.
passages.vernacular: 我喺我房間裡搵到嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在我房間裡找到的。

passages.original: I like the work well.
passages.vernacular: 我鍾意呢個花樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我喜歡這花樣。

passages.original: Ere it be demanded, As like enough it will, I’d have it copied.
passages.vernacular: 喺有人嚟要之前(好有可能會),我要把佢描低。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在有人來要之前(很可能會),我要把它描下來。

passages.original: Take it, and do ’t, and leave me for this time.
passages.vernacular: 拎去,描吧,今次先離開我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拿去,描吧,這次先離開我。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Leave you, wherefore?
passages.vernacular: 離開你,點解?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 離開你,為什麼?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I do attend here on the general, And think it no addition, nor my wish, To have him see me woman’d.
passages.vernacular: 我喺度等將軍,我認為,我也唔希望,畀佢見到我被女人纏住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在這裡等將軍,我認為,我也不希望,讓他看見我被女人纏著。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Why, I pray you?
passages.vernacular: 咦,請問點解?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,請問為什麼?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Not that I love you not.
passages.vernacular: 唔係因為我唔愛你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是因為我不愛你。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: But that you do not love me.
passages.vernacular: 而係因為你唔愛我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而是因為你不愛我。

passages.original: I pray you bring me on the way a little, And say if I shall see you soon at night.
passages.vernacular: 請你送我一小段路,告訴我今晚會唔會好快見到你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你送我一小段路,告訴我今晚會不會很快見到你。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: ’Tis but a little way that I can bring you, For I attend here.
passages.vernacular: 我只能送你一小段路,因為我要喺度等候。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我只能送你一小段路,因為我要在這裡等候。

passages.original: But I’ll see you soon.
passages.vernacular: 不過我好快會去見你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不過我很快會去見你。

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: ’Tis very good; I must be circumstanc’d.
passages.vernacular: 好好;我必須順從境況。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很好;我必須順從境況。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene I — Cyprus. Before the Castle 第四幕第一場:塞浦路斯城堡前

passages.original: Enter Othello and Iago.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅同伊阿古上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅和伊阿古上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Will you think so?
passages.vernacular: 你會咁想嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會這麼想嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Think so, Iago?
passages.vernacular: 咁想,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這麼想,伊阿古?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What, To kiss in private?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,私下接吻?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,私下接吻?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: An unauthoriz’d kiss.
passages.vernacular: 未經許可嘅吻。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 未經許可的吻。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Or to be naked with her friend in bed An hour or more, not meaning any harm?
passages.vernacular: 或者同佢嘅朋友赤身躺喺床上一小時以上,卻不含惡意?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 或者與她的朋友赤身躺在床上一小時以上,卻不含惡意?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Naked in bed, Iago, and not mean harm?
passages.vernacular: 赤身喺床,伊阿古,卻不含惡意?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 赤身在床,伊阿古,卻不含惡意?

passages.original: It is hypocrisy against the devil: They that mean virtuously and yet do so, The devil their virtue tempts, and they tempt heaven.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係對魔鬼嘅偽善:嗰啲存心貞潔卻咁樣做嘅人,魔鬼誘惑佢哋嘅美德,佢哋就喺誘惑上天。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是對魔鬼的偽善:那些存心貞潔卻這樣做的人,魔鬼誘惑他們的美德,他們就在誘惑上天。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: So they do nothing, ’tis a venial slip.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢哋乜嘢都不做,呢只係個可原諒嘅小過失。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他們什麼都不做,這只是個可原諒的小過失。

passages.original: But if I give my wife a handkerchief—
passages.vernacular: 但如果我畀我妻子一條手帕——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但如果我給我妻子一條手帕——

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What then?
passages.vernacular: 嗰又點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那又怎樣?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why then, ’tis hers, my lord, and being hers, She may, I think, bestow’t on any man.
passages.vernacular: 咁佢就係佢嘅,大人,既然係佢嘅,我想佢可以把佢送畀任何男人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼它就是她的,大人,既然是她的,我想她可以把它送給任何男人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: She is protectress of her honour too.
passages.vernacular: 佢都係自己名譽嘅保護者。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她也是自己名譽的保護者。

passages.original: May she give that?
passages.vernacular: 佢可以把嗰個都送出嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她可以把那個也送出嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Her honour is an essence that’s not seen; They have it very oft that have it not:
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅名譽係一種睇唔見嘅本質;冇名譽嘅人往往卻擁有佢:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她的名譽是一種看不見的本質;沒有名譽的人往往卻擁有它:

passages.original: But for the handkerchief—
passages.vernacular: 但講到手帕——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但說到手帕——

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: By heaven, I would most gladly have forgot it.
passages.vernacular: 天啊,我幾咁希望忘掉佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,我多麼希望忘掉它。

passages.original: Thou said’st (O, it comes o’er my memory, As doth the raven o’er the infected house, Boding to all) he had my handkerchief.
passages.vernacular: 你講過(啊,佢掠過我嘅記憶,就像烏鴉飛過染疫嘅屋子,對所有人都預告不祥)佢有我嘅手帕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說過(啊,它掠過我的記憶,就像烏鴉飛過染疫的屋子,對所有人都預告不祥)他有我的手帕。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ay, what of that?
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,嗰又點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,那又怎樣?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That’s not so good now.
passages.vernacular: 而家呢不太好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在這不太好。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What If I had said I had seen him do you wrong?
passages.vernacular: 如果我講我見佢對你做咗壞事呢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我說我見他對你做了壞事呢?

passages.original: Or heard him say (as knaves be such abroad, Who having, by their own importunate suit, Or voluntary dotage of some mistress, Convinced or supplied them, cannot choose But they must blab.)
passages.vernacular: 或者聽到佢講(外面有咁樣嘅惡棍,佢哋憑自己不斷嘅追求,或某個情婦自願嘅癡迷,講服或滿足咗佢哋,就忍不住要胡講。)
passages.vernacularMandarin: 或者聽到他說(外面有這樣的惡棍,他們憑自己不斷的追求,或某個情婦自願的癡迷,說服或滿足了她們,就忍不住要胡說。)

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Hath he said anything?
passages.vernacular: 佢講咗乜嘢嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說了什麼嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He hath, my lord, but be you well assur’d, No more than he’ll unswear.
passages.vernacular: 佢講喇,大人,不過您放心,唔會超過佢會否認嘅程度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說了,大人,不過您放心,不會超過他會否認的程度。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What hath he said?
passages.vernacular: 佢講咗乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說了什麼?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Faith, that he did—I know not what he did.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,佢做喇——我唔知道佢做咗乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,他做了——我不知道他做了什麼。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What? What?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢?乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼?什麼?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Lie.
passages.vernacular: 同瞓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同睡。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: With her?
passages.vernacular: 同佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同她?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: With her, on her, what you will.
passages.vernacular: 同佢,喺佢身上,隨您點講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 同她,在她身上,隨您怎麼說。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Lie with her!
passages.vernacular: 同佢同瞓!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 與她同睡!

passages.original: lie on her!—We say lie on her when they belie her.—Lie with her!
passages.vernacular: 喺佢身上瞓!——當人誣衊佢時,我哋講「喺佢身上講謊」。——同佢同瞓!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在她身上睡!——當人誣衊她時,我們說「在她身上說謊」。——與她同睡!

passages.original: that’s fulsome.
passages.vernacular: 嗰太下流。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那太下流。

passages.original: Handkerchief—confessions—handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 手帕——招供——手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 手帕——招供——手帕!

passages.original: To confess, and be hanged for his labour.
passages.vernacular: 招供,然後為佢嘅辛勞被絞死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 招供,然後為他的辛勞被絞死。

passages.original: First, to be hanged, and then to confess.
passages.vernacular: 先被絞死,再招供。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先被絞死,再招供。

passages.original: I tremble at it.
passages.vernacular: 我為此發抖。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我為此發抖。

passages.original: Nature would not invest herself in such shadowing passion without some instruction.
passages.vernacular: 天性若冇某種啟示,唔會披上咁樣陰影般嘅激情。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天性若沒有某種啟示,不會披上這樣陰影般的激情。

passages.original: It is not words that shake me thus. Pish!
passages.vernacular: 讓我咁樣顫抖嘅唔係言語。呸!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我這樣顫抖的不是言語。呸!

passages.original: Noses, ears, and lips.
passages.vernacular: 鼻子,耳朵,嘴唇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 鼻子,耳朵,嘴唇。

passages.original: Is’t possible?—Confess?—handkerchief?—O devil!—
passages.vernacular: 有可能嗎?——招供?——手帕?——啊,魔鬼!——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有可能嗎?——招供?——手帕?——啊,魔鬼!——

passages.original: [Falls in a trance.]
passages.vernacular: [昏倒喺恍惚中。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [昏倒在恍惚中。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Work on, My medicine, work!
passages.vernacular: 繼續發作吧,我嘅藥,起作用吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 繼續發作吧,我的藥,起作用吧!

passages.original: Thus credulous fools are caught, And many worthy and chaste dames even thus, All guiltless, meet reproach. What, ho! my lord!
passages.vernacular: 輕信嘅傻瓜就係咁樣上當,許多可敬貞潔嘅夫人都係咁樣,全然無辜卻蒙受責難。喂,大人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 輕信的傻瓜就是這樣上當,許多可敬貞潔的夫人也是這樣,全然無辜卻蒙受責難。喂,大人!

passages.original: My lord, I say! Othello!
passages.vernacular: 大人,我講!奧賽羅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,我說!奧賽羅!

passages.original: Enter Cassio.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How now, Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 點喇,凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,凱西奧!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: What’s the matter?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: My lord is fallen into an epilepsy.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅大人癲癇發作喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的大人癲癇發作了。

passages.original: This is his second fit.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係佢第二次發作。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是他第二次發作。

passages.original: He had one yesterday.
passages.vernacular: 尋日發作過一次。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 昨天發作過一次。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Rub him about the temples.
passages.vernacular: 揉佢嘅太陽穴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 揉他的太陽穴。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: No, forbear; The lethargy must have his quiet course.
passages.vernacular: 不,別動;昏迷必須安靜地走完佢嘅過程。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,別動;昏迷必須安靜地走完它的過程。

passages.original: If not, he foams at mouth, and by and by Breaks out to savage madness.
passages.vernacular: 否則佢會口吐白沫,不久便爆發野蠻嘅狂亂。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 否則他會口吐白沫,不久便爆發野蠻的狂亂。

passages.original: Look, he stirs: Do you withdraw yourself a little while, He will recover straight.
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢動喇:你暫時迴避一下,佢好快會恢復。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,他動了:你暫時迴避一下,他很快會恢復。

passages.original: When he is gone, I would on great occasion speak with you.
passages.vernacular: 等佢走喇,我有重要嘅事要同你談。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 等他走了,我有重要的事要和你談。

passages.original: [Exit Cassio.]
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧下。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How is it, general?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,將軍?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼樣,將軍?

passages.original: Have you not hurt your head?
passages.vernacular: 你冇傷到頭吧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你沒有傷到頭吧?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Dost thou mock me?
passages.vernacular: 你喺嘲弄我嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你在嘲弄我嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I mock you?
passages.vernacular: 我嘲弄你?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我嘲弄你?

passages.original: No, by heaven.
passages.vernacular: 不,憑天發誓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,憑天發誓。

passages.original: Would you would bear your fortune like a man!
passages.vernacular: 但願您能像個男子漢嗰樣承受命運!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願您能像個男子漢那樣承受命運!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: A horned man’s a monster and a beast.
passages.vernacular: 長角嘅男人係怪物同野獸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 長角的男人是怪物和野獸。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: There’s many a beast, then, in a populous city, And many a civil monster.
passages.vernacular: 咁,喺人口稠密嘅城市裡有許多野獸,都有許多文明嘅怪物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,在人口稠密的城市裡有許多野獸,也有許多文明的怪物。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Did he confess it?
passages.vernacular: 佢招認咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他招認了嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Good sir, be a man.
passages.vernacular: 好先生,做個男子漢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好先生,做個男子漢。

passages.original: Think every bearded fellow that’s but yok’d May draw with you.
passages.vernacular: 想想每一個有鬍子嘅、被套上軛嘅人,都可以同你同拉一輛車。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想想每一個有鬍子的、被套上軛的人,都可以與你同拉一輛車。

passages.original: There’s millions now alive That nightly lie in those unproper beds Which they dare swear peculiar: your case is better.
passages.vernacular: 而家活住嘅有成百萬人,夜夜瞓喺佢哋敢發誓只屬於自己嘅不潔床上:您嘅情況仲好些。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在活著的有成百萬人,夜夜睡在他們敢發誓只屬於自己的不潔床上:您的情況還好些。

passages.original: O, ’tis the spite of hell, the fiend’s arch-mock, To lip a wanton in a secure couch, And to suppose her chaste!
passages.vernacular: 啊,呢個係地獄嘅惡意、魔鬼最大嘅嘲弄:喺安穩嘅床上親吻一個蕩婦,卻仲以為佢貞潔!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,這是地獄的惡意、魔鬼最大的嘲弄:在安穩的床上親吻一個蕩婦,卻還以為她貞潔!

passages.original: No, let me know, And knowing what I am, I know what she shall be.
passages.vernacular: 不,讓我知道,知道咗我係乜嘢,我就知道佢將成乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,讓我知道,知道了我是什麼,我就知道她將成什麼。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, thou art wise, ’tis certain.
passages.vernacular: 啊,你係明智嘅,呢個係肯定嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,你是明智的,這是肯定的。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Stand you awhile apart, Confine yourself but in a patient list.
passages.vernacular: 您暫時站到一旁,把自己限制喺耐心嘅界限內。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您暫時站到一旁,把自己限制在耐心的界限內。

passages.original: Whilst you were here o’erwhelmed with your grief, (A passion most unsuiting such a man) Cassio came hither.
passages.vernacular: 您喺呢度被悲痛壓倒時(呢種激情最不適合您咁樣嘅人),凱西奧嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您在這裡被悲痛壓倒時(這種激情最不適合您這樣的人),凱西奧來了。

passages.original: I shifted him away, And laid good ’scuse upon your ecstasy, Bade him anon return, and here speak with me, The which he promis’d.
passages.vernacular: 我把佢支走喇,並用好理由解釋您嘅失神,叫佢稍後回嚟,喺呢度同我談話,佢答應喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我把他支走了,並用好理由解釋您的失神,叫他稍後回來,在這裡與我談話,他答應了。

passages.original: Do but encave yourself, And mark the fleers, the gibes, and notable scorns, That dwell in every region of his face;
passages.vernacular: 只要您躲進洞裡,留意佢臉上每一處嘅嘲笑、譏諷同明顯嘅輕蔑;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只要您躲進洞裡,留意他臉上每一處的嘲笑、譏諷和明顯的輕蔑;

passages.original: For I will make him tell the tale anew, Where, how, how oft, how long ago, and when He hath, and is again to cope your wife:
passages.vernacular: 因為我要讓佢重新講述,喺邊度、點樣、多少次、多久以前、乜嘢時候,佢曾經並將再次同您妻子苟合:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為我要讓他重新講述,在哪裡、怎樣、多少次、多久以前、什麼時候,他曾經並將再次與您妻子苟合:

passages.original: I say, but mark his gesture.
passages.vernacular: 我講,只要留意佢嘅姿態。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說,只要留意他的姿態。

passages.original: Marry, patience, Or I shall say you are all in all in spleen, And nothing of a man.
passages.vernacular: 當然,要耐心,否則我就會講您整個人都係怒氣,啲男子氣概都冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當然,要耐心,否則我就會說您整個人都是怒氣,一點男子氣概都沒有。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Dost thou hear, Iago?
passages.vernacular: 你聽到嗎,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你聽到嗎,伊阿古?

passages.original: I will be found most cunning in my patience; But,—dost thou hear?—most bloody.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅耐心會被發現最為狡猾;但——你聽到嗎?——最為血腥。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的耐心會被發現最為狡猾;但——你聽到嗎?——最為血腥。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: That’s not amiss.
passages.vernacular: 嗰冇錯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那沒有錯。

passages.original: But yet keep time in all.
passages.vernacular: 但一切都要合拍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但一切都要合拍。

passages.original: Will you withdraw?
passages.vernacular: 您願意迴避嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您願意迴避嗎?

passages.original: [Othello withdraws.]
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅退到一旁。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅退到一旁。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Now will I question Cassio of Bianca, A housewife that by selling her desires Buys herself bread and clothes:
passages.vernacular: 而家我要向凱西奧問比安卡,一個靠出賣慾望為自己換取衣食嘅婦人:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在我要向凱西奧問比安卡,一個靠出賣慾望為自己換取衣食的婦人:

passages.original: it is a creature That dotes on Cassio, (as ’tis the strumpet’s plague To beguile many and be beguil’d by one.)
passages.vernacular: 佢迷戀凱西奧(娼婦嘅災難就係騙咗許多人,卻被一個人所騙。)
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她迷戀凱西奧(娼婦的災難就是騙了許多人,卻被一個人所騙。)

passages.original: He, when he hears of her, cannot refrain From the excess of laughter.
passages.vernacular: 佢一聽到佢,就忍不住大笑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他一聽到她,就忍不住大笑。

passages.original: Here he comes.
passages.vernacular: 佢嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他來了。

passages.original: Enter Cassio.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: As he shall smile Othello shall go mad, And his unbookish jealousy must construe Poor Cassio’s smiles, gestures, and light behaviour Quite in the wrong.
passages.vernacular: 佢一微笑,奧賽羅就會發瘋,而佢嗰不通書本嘅嫉妒,必定把可憐凱西奧嘅微笑、姿態同輕浮舉止完全解讀錯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他一微笑,奧賽羅就會發瘋,而他那不通書本的嫉妒,必定把可憐凱西奧的微笑、姿態和輕浮舉止完全解讀錯。

passages.original: How do you now, lieutenant?
passages.vernacular: 你而家點樣,副官?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你現在怎樣,副官?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: The worser that you give me the addition Whose want even kills me.
passages.vernacular: 你畀我呢個頭銜,只讓我更糟,因為缺少佢幾乎要咗我嘅命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你給我這個頭銜,只讓我更糟,因為缺少它幾乎要了我的命。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ply Desdemona well, and you are sure on’t.
passages.vernacular: 好好求戴絲德夢娜,你一定成功。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好好求戴絲德夢娜,你一定成功。

passages.original: [Speaking lower.]
passages.vernacular: [聲音放低。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [聲音放低。]

passages.original: Now, if this suit lay in Bianca’s power, How quickly should you speed!
passages.vernacular: 而家,如果呢請求喺比安卡嘅力量之內,你會多快成功!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,如果這請求在比安卡的力量之內,你會多快成功!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Alas, poor caitiff!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,可憐嘅傢伙!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,可憐的傢伙!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Aside.]
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]

passages.original: Look how he laughs already!
passages.vernacular: 睇佢已經喺笑喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看他已經在笑了!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I never knew a woman love man so.
passages.vernacular: 我從未見過一個女人咁樣愛一個男人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我從未見過一個女人這樣愛一個男人。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Alas, poor rogue!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,可憐嘅小流氓!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,可憐的小流氓!

passages.original: I think, i’ faith, she loves me.
passages.vernacular: 我想,講真嘅,佢愛我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想,說真的,她愛我。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Aside.]
passages.vernacular: [旁白。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [旁白。]

passages.original: Now he denies it faintly and laughs it out.
passages.vernacular: 而家佢微弱地否認,又用笑掩飾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在他微弱地否認,又用笑掩飾。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do you hear, Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 你聽到嗎,凱西奧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你聽到嗎,凱西奧?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Now he importunes him To tell it o’er.
passages.vernacular: 而家佢催促佢再講一遍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在他催促他再講一遍。

passages.original: Go to, well said, well said.
passages.vernacular: 講吧,講得好,講得好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說吧,說得好,說得好。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: She gives it out that you shall marry her.
passages.vernacular: 佢放風講你會娶佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她放風說你會娶她。

passages.original: Do you intend it?
passages.vernacular: 你有此打算嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你有此打算嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Ha, ha, ha!
passages.vernacular: 哈,哈,哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈,哈,哈!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Do you triumph, Roman?
passages.vernacular: 你得意咗吧,羅馬人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你得意了吧,羅馬人?

passages.original: Do you triumph?
passages.vernacular: 你得意嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你得意嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I marry her? What? A customer?
passages.vernacular: 我娶佢?乜嘢?一個嫖客嘅女人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我娶她?什麼?一個嫖客的女人?

passages.original: I prithee, bear some charity to my wit, do not think it so unwholesome. Ha, ha, ha!
passages.vernacular: 請你對我嘅頭腦寬容啲,別認為佢咁不健康。哈,哈,哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你對我的頭腦寬容一點,別認為它這麼不健康。哈,哈,哈!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: So, so, so, so.
passages.vernacular: 係,係,係,係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,是,是,是。

passages.original: They laugh that wins.
passages.vernacular: 贏嘅人才笑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 贏的人才笑。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Faith, the cry goes that you shall marry her.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,傳言講你會娶佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,傳言說你會娶她。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Prithee say true.
passages.vernacular: 請講實話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請說實話。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am a very villain else.
passages.vernacular: 否則我就係十足嘅惡棍。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 否則我就是十足的惡棍。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Have you scored me? Well.
passages.vernacular: 你畀我記賬咗嗎?好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你給我記賬了嗎?好。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: This is the monkey’s own giving out.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係嗰隻猴子自己放嘅風。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是那隻猴子自己放的風。

passages.original: She is persuaded I will marry her, out of her own love and flattery, not out of my promise.
passages.vernacular: 佢自以為我會娶佢,係出於佢自己嘅愛同自負,而唔係出於我嘅承諾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她自以為我會娶她,是出於她自己的愛和自負,而不是出於我的承諾。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Iago beckons me.
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古向我招手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古向我招手。

passages.original: Now he begins the story.
passages.vernacular: 而家佢開始講故事喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在他開始講故事了。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: She was here even now.
passages.vernacular: 佢頭先仲喺呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她剛才還在這裡。

passages.original: She haunts me in every place.
passages.vernacular: 佢到處纏住我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她到處纏著我。

passages.original: I was the other day talking on the sea-bank with certain Venetians, and thither comes the bauble, and falls thus about my neck.
passages.vernacular: 前幾天我喺海岸同幾個威尼斯人談話,嗰個小玩意就嚟喇,咁樣撲到我脖子上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 前幾天我在海岸與幾個威尼斯人談話,那個小玩意就來了,這樣撲到我脖子上。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Crying, “O dear Cassio!”
passages.vernacular: 喊住「啊,親愛嘅凱西奧!」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喊著「啊,親愛的凱西奧!」

passages.original: as it were: his gesture imports it.
passages.vernacular: 大概如此:佢嘅姿勢表示出嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大概如此:他的姿勢表示出來了。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: So hangs, and lolls, and weeps upon me; so hales and pulls me. Ha, ha, ha!
passages.vernacular: 咁樣掛住、賴住、對我哭泣;咁樣拖我、扯我。哈,哈,哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣掛著、賴著、對我哭泣;這樣拖我、扯我。哈,哈,哈!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Now he tells how she plucked him to my chamber.
passages.vernacular: 而家佢講佢點樣把佢拽進我嘅房間。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在他說她怎樣把他拽進我的房間。

passages.original: O, I see that nose of yours, but not that dog I shall throw it to.
passages.vernacular: 啊,我睇見你嘅鼻子,卻睇唔見我要把佢扔畀嘅嗰條狗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我看見你的鼻子,卻看不見我要把它扔給的那條狗。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Well, I must leave her company.
passages.vernacular: 好,我必須離開佢嘅陪伴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我必須離開她的陪伴。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Before me!
passages.vernacular: 天啊!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊!

passages.original: look where she comes.
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,她來了。

passages.original: Enter Bianca.
passages.vernacular: [比安卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [比安卡上。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: ’Tis such another fitchew!
passages.vernacular: 又係一隻咁樣嘅臭鼬!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 又是一隻這樣的臭鼬!

passages.original: Marry, a perfum’d one.
passages.vernacular: 當然,係一隻香水味嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當然,是一隻香水味的。

passages.original: What do you mean by this haunting of me?
passages.vernacular: 你咁樣纏住我係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這樣纏著我是什麼意思?

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Let the devil and his dam haunt you!
passages.vernacular: 讓魔鬼同佢母親去纏你吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓魔鬼和他母親去纏你吧!

passages.original: What did you mean by that same handkerchief you gave me even now?
passages.vernacular: 你頭先畀我嘅嗰條手帕係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你剛才給我的那條手帕是什麼意思?

passages.original: I was a fine fool to take it.
passages.vernacular: 我攞佢真係個大傻瓜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我拿它真是個大傻瓜。

passages.original: I must take out the work?
passages.vernacular: 我要把花樣描下嚟?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要把花樣描下來?

passages.original: A likely piece of work, that you should find it in your chamber and not know who left it there!
passages.vernacular: 好一個像樣嘅講法:你喺自己房間找到佢,卻唔知道邊個丟喺嗰兒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好一個像樣的說法:你在自己房間找到它,卻不知道誰丟在那兒!

passages.original: This is some minx’s token, and I must take out the work?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係邊個賤人嘅信物,我仲要把花樣描下嚟?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是哪個賤人的信物,我還要把花樣描下來?

passages.original: There, give it your hobby-horse.
passages.vernacular: 喏,攞去畀你嘅玩物。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喏,拿去給你的玩物。

passages.original: Wheresoever you had it, I’ll take out no work on’t.
passages.vernacular: 無論你從邊度得嚟,我不描佢嘅花樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 無論你從哪裡得來,我不描它的花樣。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: How now, my sweet Bianca?
passages.vernacular: 點喇,我甜美嘅比安卡?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,我甜美的比安卡?

passages.original: How now, how now?
passages.vernacular: 點喇,點喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,怎麼了?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: By heaven, that should be my handkerchief!
passages.vernacular: 天啊,嗰應該係我嘅手帕!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,那應該是我的手帕!

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: If you’ll come to supper tonight, you may.
passages.vernacular: 如果你今晚嚟食晚飯,可以。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你今晚來吃晚飯,可以。

passages.original: If you will not, come when you are next prepared for.
passages.vernacular: 如果不嚟,下次有準備時再嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果不來,下次有準備時再來。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: After her, after her.
passages.vernacular: 追上佢,追上佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 追上她,追上她。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Faith, I must; she’ll rail in the street else.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我必須去;否則佢會喺街上大罵。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我必須去;否則她會在街上大罵。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Will you sup there?
passages.vernacular: 你喺嗰度食晚飯嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你在那裡吃晚飯嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Faith, I intend so.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我打算去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我打算去。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Well, I may chance to see you, for I would very fain speak with you.
passages.vernacular: 好,我或者會碰到你,因為我好想同你談談。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我也許會碰到你,因為我很想與你談談。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Prithee come, will you?
passages.vernacular: 請你嚟吧,好嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你來吧,好嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Go to; say no more.
passages.vernacular: 好喇,唔好再講喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好了,別再說了。

passages.original: [Exit Cassio.]
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧下。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Coming forward.]
passages.vernacular: [上前。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [上前。]

passages.original: How shall I murder him, Iago?
passages.vernacular: 我該點樣殺佢,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我該怎樣殺他,伊阿古?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Did you perceive how he laughed at his vice?
passages.vernacular: 你睇到佢點樣嘲笑自己嘅惡行嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看到他怎樣嘲笑自己的惡行嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O Iago!
passages.vernacular: 啊伊阿古!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊伊阿古!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And did you see the handkerchief?
passages.vernacular: 你睇到手帕咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看到手帕了嗎?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Was that mine?
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係我嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是我的嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Yours, by this hand: and to see how he prizes the foolish woman your wife!
passages.vernacular: 係您嘅,憑呢隻手:睇佢多重視嗰個愚蠢嘅女人,您嘅妻子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是您的,憑這隻手:看他多重視那個愚蠢的女人,您的妻子!

passages.original: she gave it him, and he hath given it his whore.
passages.vernacular: 佢畀咗佢,佢又送畀咗佢嘅娼妓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她給了他,他又送給了他的娼妓。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I would have him nine years a-killing.
passages.vernacular: 我要佢死上九年。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要他死上九年。

passages.original: A fine woman, a fair woman, a sweet woman!
passages.vernacular: 一個好女人,美麗嘅女人,甜美嘅女人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個好女人,美麗的女人,甜美的女人!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, you must forget that.
passages.vernacular: 不,您必須忘掉呢點。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,您必須忘掉這點。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, let her rot, and perish, and be damned tonight, for she shall not live.
passages.vernacular: 係,讓佢今晚腐爛、滅亡、受詛咒,因為佢唔能夠活。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,讓她今晚腐爛、滅亡、受詛咒,因為她不能活。

passages.original: No, my heart is turned to stone; I strike it, and it hurts my hand.
passages.vernacular: 不,我嘅心變成咗石頭;我捶佢,卻傷咗我嘅手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我的心變成了石頭;我捶它,卻傷了我的手。

passages.original: O, the world hath not a sweeter creature.
passages.vernacular: 啊,世上冇更甜美嘅人喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,世上沒有更甜美的人了。

passages.original: She might lie by an emperor’s side, and command him tasks.
passages.vernacular: 佢可以躺喺皇帝身邊,指派佢做事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她可以躺在皇帝身邊,指派他做事。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Nay, that’s not your way.
passages.vernacular: 不,呢唔係您該有嘅方式。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,這不是您該有的方式。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Hang her, I do but say what she is.
passages.vernacular: 該死,我只係講佢係點樣嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 該死,我只是說她是怎樣的人。

passages.original: So delicate with her needle, an admirable musician!
passages.vernacular: 針線活咁精巧,係位出色嘅音樂家!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 針線活那麼精巧,是位出色的音樂家!

passages.original: O, she will sing the savageness out of a bear!
passages.vernacular: 啊,佢能唱得熊都失去野性!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,她能唱得熊都失去野性!

passages.original: Of so high and plenteous wit and invention!
passages.vernacular: 才智同創造力咁高、咁豐富!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 才智和創造力那麼高、那麼豐富!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: She’s the worse for all this.
passages.vernacular: 就因為呢啲,佢更糟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就因為這些,她更糟。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, a thousand, a thousand times: and then of so gentle a condition!
passages.vernacular: 啊,千倍,千倍:而且品性咁溫柔!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,千倍,千倍:而且品性那麼溫柔!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ay, too gentle.
passages.vernacular: 係,太溫柔喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,太溫柔了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nay, that’s certain.
passages.vernacular: 不,呢個係肯定嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,這是肯定的。

passages.original: But yet the pity of it, Iago!
passages.vernacular: 但係呢多可惜,伊阿古!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但是這多可惜,伊阿古!

passages.original: O Iago, the pity of it, Iago!
passages.vernacular: 啊伊阿古,幾咁可惜,伊阿古!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊伊阿古,多麼可惜,伊阿古!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: If you are so fond over her iniquity, give her patent to offend, for if it touch not you, it comes near nobody.
passages.vernacular: 如果您對佢嘅罪惡如此癡情,就畀佢作惡嘅特許,因為如果呢不觸及您,就冇人會被觸及。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果您對她的罪惡如此癡情,就給她作惡的特許,因為如果這不觸及您,就沒有人會被觸及。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I will chop her into messes. Cuckold me!
passages.vernacular: 我要把佢剁成肉塊。畀我戴綠帽!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要把她剁成肉塊。給我戴綠帽!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, ’tis foul in her.
passages.vernacular: 啊,佢太卑鄙喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,她太卑鄙了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: With mine officer!
passages.vernacular: 仲跟我嘅軍官!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還跟我的軍官!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: That’s fouler.
passages.vernacular: 嗰更卑鄙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那更卑鄙。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Get me some poison, Iago; this night.
passages.vernacular: 畀我弄點毒藥,伊阿古;今晚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我弄點毒藥,伊阿古;今晚。

passages.original: I’ll not expostulate with her, lest her body and beauty unprovide my mind again.
passages.vernacular: 我不同佢理論,免得佢嘅身體同美貌又使我嘅決心瓦解。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不與她理論,免得她的身體和美貌又使我的決心瓦解。

passages.original: This night, Iago.
passages.vernacular: 今晚,伊阿古。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 今晚,伊阿古。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do it not with poison, strangle her in her bed, even the bed she hath contaminated.
passages.vernacular: 唔好用毒藥,喺佢床上把佢勒死,就喺佢玷污嘅嗰張床上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要用毒藥,在她床上把她勒死,就在她玷污的那張床上。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Good, good.
passages.vernacular: 好,好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,好。

passages.original: The justice of it pleases. Very good.
passages.vernacular: 呢公正令我滿意。好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這公正令我滿意。很好。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And for Cassio, let me be his undertaker.
passages.vernacular: 至於凱西奧,讓我嚟承包佢嘅後事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 至於凱西奧,讓我來承包他的後事。

passages.original: You shall hear more by midnight.
passages.vernacular: 午夜前你會聽到更多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 午夜前你會聽到更多。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Excellent good.
passages.vernacular: 好極喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好極了。

passages.original: [A trumpet within.]
passages.vernacular: [內有號角聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有號角聲。]

passages.original: What trumpet is that same?
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係乜嘢號角?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是什麼號角?

passages.original: Enter Lodovico, Desdemona and Attendant.
passages.vernacular: [洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜同侍從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜和侍從上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Something from Venice, sure.
passages.vernacular: 肯定係威尼斯嚟嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯定是威尼斯來的。

passages.original: ’Tis Lodovico Come from the duke.
passages.vernacular: 係洛多維科,從公爵嗰度嚟嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是洛多維科,從公爵那裡來的。

passages.original: See, your wife is with him.
passages.vernacular: 睇,您妻子跟佢喺一起。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,您妻子跟他在一起。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Save you, worthy general!
passages.vernacular: 向您問安,尊貴嘅將軍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向您問安,尊貴的將軍!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: With all my heart, sir.
passages.vernacular: 衷心感謝,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 衷心感謝,先生。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: The duke and senators of Venice greet you.
passages.vernacular: 威尼斯公爵同議員哋向您問候。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 威尼斯公爵和議員們向您問候。

passages.original: [Gives him a packet.]
passages.vernacular: [遞畀佢一包文件。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [遞給他一包文件。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I kiss the instrument of their pleasures.
passages.vernacular: 我親吻佢哋意願嘅文書。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我親吻他們意願的文書。

passages.original: [Opens the packet and reads.]
passages.vernacular: [打開文件閱讀。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [打開文件閱讀。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: And what’s the news, good cousin Lodovico?
passages.vernacular: 有乜嘢消息,好堂兄洛多維科?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有什麼消息,好堂兄洛多維科?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I am very glad to see you, signior.
passages.vernacular: 我好高興見到您,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興見到您,大人。

passages.original: Welcome to Cyprus.
passages.vernacular: 歡迎嚟到塞浦路斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 歡迎來到塞浦路斯。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: I thank you.
passages.vernacular: 謝謝您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謝謝您。

passages.original: How does Lieutenant Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧副官好嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧副官好嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Lives, sir.
passages.vernacular: 活住,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 活著,先生。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Cousin, there’s fall’n between him and my lord An unkind breach, but you shall make all well.
passages.vernacular: 堂兄,佢同我丈夫之間出現咗不愉快嘅裂痕,但你會讓一切恢復。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 堂兄,他和我丈夫之間出現了不愉快的裂痕,但你會讓一切恢復。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Are you sure of that?
passages.vernacular: 你確定嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你確定嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [Reads.]
“This fail you not to do, as you will—”
passages.vernacular: 「你務必照此行事,隨你——」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「你務必照此行事,隨你——」

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: He did not call; he’s busy in the paper.
passages.vernacular: 佢冇叫你;佢喺忙住睇文件。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他沒有叫你;他在忙著看文件。

passages.original: Is there division ’twixt my lord and Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 我丈夫同凱西奧之間有分歧嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我丈夫和凱西奧之間有分歧嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: A most unhappy one.
passages.vernacular: 好不幸嘅分歧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常不幸的分歧。

passages.original: I would do much To atone them, for the love I bear to Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 為了我對凱西奧嘅愛,我願意盡力讓佢哋和解。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了我對凱西奧的愛,我願意盡力讓他們和解。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Fire and brimstone!
passages.vernacular: 烈火同硫磺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 烈火與硫磺!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Are you wise?
passages.vernacular: 你神志清醒嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你神志清醒嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: What, is he angry?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,佢生氣喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,他生氣了?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: May be the letter mov’d him; For, as I think, they do command him home, Deputing Cassio in his government.
passages.vernacular: 或者係信打動咗佢;因為我想,佢哋命令佢回國,由凱西奧接任佢嘅總督職位。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也許是信打動了他;因為我想,他們命令他回國,由凱西奧接任他的總督職位。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Trust me, I am glad on’t.
passages.vernacular: 相信我,我為此高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 相信我,我為此高興。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Indeed!
passages.vernacular: 真嘅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I am glad to see you mad.
passages.vernacular: 睇到你發瘋,我好高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看到你發瘋,我很高興。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Why, sweet Othello?
passages.vernacular: 點解,親愛嘅奧賽羅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為什麼,親愛的奧賽羅?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Devil!
passages.vernacular: 魔鬼!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 魔鬼!

passages.original: [Striking her.]
passages.vernacular: [打佢。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [打她。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have not deserv’d this.
passages.vernacular: 我不該受呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不該受這個。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: My lord, this would not be believ’d in Venice, Though I should swear I saw’t: ’tis very much.
passages.vernacular: 大人,呢喺威尼斯唔會有人相信,即使我發誓親眼睇到:呢太過分喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,這在威尼斯不會有人相信,即使我發誓親眼看到:這太過分了。

passages.original: Make her amends. She weeps.
passages.vernacular: 向佢賠罪吧。佢哭喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向她賠罪吧。她哭了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O devil, devil!
passages.vernacular: 啊,魔鬼,魔鬼!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,魔鬼,魔鬼!

passages.original: If that the earth could teem with woman’s tears, Each drop she falls would prove a crocodile.
passages.vernacular: 如果大地能孕育女人嘅眼淚,佢落下嘅每一滴都會變成鱷魚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果大地能孕育女人的眼淚,她落下的每一滴都會變成鱷魚。

passages.original: Out of my sight!
passages.vernacular: 滾出我嘅視線!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 滾出我的視線!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will not stay to offend you.
passages.vernacular: 我不留下嚟冒犯你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不留下來冒犯你。

passages.original: [Going.]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Truly, an obedient lady.
passages.vernacular: 真係一位順從嘅夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真是一位順從的夫人。

passages.original: I do beseech your lordship, call her back.
passages.vernacular: 我懇求大人,叫佢回嚟。
