passages.vernacularMandarin: 我懇求大人,叫她回來。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Mistress!
passages.vernacular: 夫人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What would you with her, sir?
passages.vernacular: 你想對佢做乜嘢,先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你想對她做什麼,先生?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Who, I, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 邊個,我,大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰,我,大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Ay, you did wish that I would make her turn.
passages.vernacular: 對,你曾希望我讓佢轉身。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,你曾希望我讓她轉身。

passages.original: Sir, she can turn, and turn, and yet go on, And turn again.
passages.vernacular: 先生,佢能轉身,再轉身,繼續走,再轉身。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,她能轉身,再轉身,繼續走,再轉身。

passages.original: And she can weep, sir, weep; And she’s obedient, as you say, obedient, Very obedient.
passages.vernacular: 佢都能哭,先生,哭;佢順從,如你所講,順從,好順從。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她也能哭,先生,哭;她順從,如你所說,順從,非常順從。

passages.original: Proceed you in your tears.
passages.vernacular: 你繼續流淚吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你繼續流淚吧。

passages.original: Concerning this, sir,—O well-painted passion!
passages.vernacular: 至於呢件事,先生——啊,畫得多好嘅激情!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 至於這件事,先生——啊,畫得多好的激情!

passages.original: I am commanded home.—Get you away; I’ll send for you anon.—Sir, I obey the mandate, And will return to Venice.—Hence, avaunt!
passages.vernacular: 我被命令回國。——你走開;我稍後會派人叫你。——先生,我服從命令,將回威尼斯。——滾開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我被命令回國。——你走開;我稍後會派人叫你。——先生,我服從命令,將回威尼斯。——滾開!

passages.original: [Exit Desdemona.]
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜下。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Cassio shall have my place.
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧將接替我嘅職位。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧將接替我的職位。

passages.original: And, sir, tonight, I do entreat that we may sup together.
passages.vernacular: 仲有,先生,今晚我請你同我哋共進晚餐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有,先生,今晚我請你與我們共進晚餐。

passages.original: You are welcome, sir, to Cyprus.
passages.vernacular: 先生,歡迎你嚟到塞浦路斯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,歡迎你來到塞浦路斯。

passages.original: Goats and monkeys!
passages.vernacular: 山羊同猴子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 山羊和猴子!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Is this the noble Moor, whom our full senate Call all in all sufficient?
passages.vernacular: 呢個就係我哋整個元老院稱為全才全能嘅高貴摩爾人嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這就是我們整個元老院稱為全才全能的高貴摩爾人嗎?

passages.original: Is this the nature Whom passion could not shake?
passages.vernacular: 呢個就係激情都無法動搖嘅本性嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這就是激情都無法動搖的本性嗎?

passages.original: whose solid virtue The shot of accident nor dart of chance Could neither graze nor pierce?
passages.vernacular: 佢堅實嘅美德,意外嘅子彈同機遇嘅飛鏢都唔能夠擦傷或刺穿?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他堅實的美德,意外的子彈和機遇的飛鏢都不能擦傷或刺穿?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He is much chang’d.
passages.vernacular: 佢變咗好多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他變了很多。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Are his wits safe?
passages.vernacular: 佢神志正常嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他神志正常嗎?

passages.original: Is he not light of brain?
passages.vernacular: 佢唔係頭腦輕浮嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不是頭腦輕浮嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He’s that he is.
passages.vernacular: 佢就係佢嗰個樣子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他就是他那個樣子。

passages.original: I may not breathe my censure What he might be.
passages.vernacular: 我不便講出我對佢可能係乜嘢嘅判斷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不便說出我對他可能是什麼的判斷。

passages.original: If what he might he is not, I would to heaven he were!
passages.vernacular: 如果佢唔係佢可能嘅樣子,我但願上天讓佢係!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果他不是他可能的樣子,我但願上天讓他是!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: What, strike his wife?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,打佢妻子?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,打他妻子?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Faith, that was not so well; yet would I knew That stroke would prove the worst!
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,嗰不太好;但我希望知道嗰一擊會係最壞嘅!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,那不太好;但我希望知道那一擊會是最壞的!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Is it his use?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係佢嘅習慣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是他的習慣嗎?

passages.original: Or did the letters work upon his blood, And new-create this fault?
passages.vernacular: 定係信件作用於佢嘅血氣,新造出呢個過失?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還是信件作用於他的血氣,新造出這個過失?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Alas, alas!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,哎呀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,哎呀!

passages.original: It is not honesty in me to speak What I have seen and known.
passages.vernacular: 我講出我所見所知,並非誠實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說出我所見所知,並非誠實。

passages.original: You shall observe him, And his own courses will denote him so That I may save my speech:
passages.vernacular: 你會觀察佢,佢自己嘅行為會顯示佢嘅樣子,我就唔使多講:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會觀察他,他自己的行為會顯示他的樣子,我就不必多說:

passages.original: do but go after, And mark how he continues.
passages.vernacular: 只管跟住去,留意佢點樣繼續。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只管跟著去,留意他怎樣繼續。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: I am sorry that I am deceiv’d in him.
passages.vernacular: 我好遺憾,我睇錯咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很遺憾,我看錯了他。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene II — Cyprus. A Room in the Castle 第四幕第二場:塞浦路斯城堡一室

passages.original: Enter Othello and Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅同愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅和愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: You have seen nothing, then?
passages.vernacular: 咁你乜嘢都冇睇到?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼你什麼都沒看到?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Nor ever heard, nor ever did suspect.
passages.vernacular: 冇聽過,都從未懷疑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒聽過,也從未懷疑。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Yes, you have seen Cassio and she together.
passages.vernacular: 不過你睇到過凱西奧同佢喺一起。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 可是你看到過凱西奧和她在一起。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: But then I saw no harm, and then I heard Each syllable that breath made up between them.
passages.vernacular: 但嗰時我冇睇到有乜嘢不妥,而且我聽到咗佢哋之間講嘅每一個音節。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但那時我沒看到有什麼不妥,而且我聽到了他們之間說的每一個音節。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What, did they never whisper?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,佢哋從不低聲講話?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,他們從不低聲說話?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Never, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 從不,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從不,大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Nor send you out o’ the way?
passages.vernacular: 都冇支開你?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也沒有支開你?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Never.
passages.vernacular: 從不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從不。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: To fetch her fan, her gloves, her mask, nor nothing?
passages.vernacular: 去攞佢嘅扇子、手套、面具,乜嘢都冇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去拿她的扇子、手套、面具,什麼都沒有?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Never, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 從不,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從不,大人。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That’s strange.
passages.vernacular: 真奇怪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真奇怪。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I durst, my lord, to wager she is honest, Lay down my soul at stake:
passages.vernacular: 大人,我敢打賭佢係貞潔嘅,攞我嘅靈魂作賭注:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,我敢打賭她是貞潔的,拿我的靈魂作賭注:

passages.original: if you think other, Remove your thought, it doth abuse your bosom.
passages.vernacular: 如果您認為唔係,請除去呢個想法,佢喺欺騙您嘅胸懷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果您認為不是,請除去這個想法,它在欺騙您的胸懷。

passages.original: If any wretch have put this in your head, Let heaven requite it with the serpent’s curse, For if she be not honest, chaste, and true, There’s no man happy.
passages.vernacular: 如果有邊個壞蛋把呢想法放進您腦裡,願上天用蛇嘅詛咒報應佢,因為如果佢不貞潔、不純潔、不忠誠,就冇邊個男人係幸福嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果有哪個壞蛋把這想法放進您腦裡,願上天用蛇的詛咒報應他,因為如果她不貞潔、不純潔、不忠誠,就沒有哪個男人是幸福的。

passages.original: The purest of their wives Is foul as slander.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋妻子中最純潔嘅,都像誹謗一樣污穢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們妻子中最純潔的,也像誹謗一樣污穢。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Bid her come hither. Go.
passages.vernacular: 叫佢過嚟。去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 叫她過來。去。

passages.original: [Exit Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞下。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: She says enough.
passages.vernacular: 佢講得夠多喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她說得夠多了。

passages.original: Yet she’s a simple bawd That cannot say as much.
passages.vernacular: 然而,講不出呢啲話嘅,都係個愚蠢嘅皮條客。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而,說不出這些話的,也是個愚蠢的皮條客。

passages.original: This is a subtle whore, A closet lock and key of villainous secrets.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係個狡猾嘅娼婦,一把鎖住卑鄙祕密嘅內室鎖同鑰匙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是個狡猾的娼婦,一把鎖住卑鄙祕密的內室鎖和鑰匙。

passages.original: And yet she’ll kneel and pray.
passages.vernacular: 然而佢仲會下跪祈禱。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而她還會下跪祈禱。

passages.original: I have seen her do ’t.
passages.vernacular: 我見過佢咁樣做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我見過她這樣做。

passages.original: Enter Desdemona and Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜同愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜和愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord, what is your will?
passages.vernacular: 大人,您有乜嘢吩咐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,您有什麼吩咐?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Pray, chuck, come hither.
passages.vernacular: 請過嚟,小雞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請過來,小雞。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: What is your pleasure?
passages.vernacular: 您想要乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您想要什麼?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Let me see your eyes.
passages.vernacular: 讓我睇睇你嘅眼睛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我看看你的眼睛。

passages.original: Look in my face.
passages.vernacular: 睇住我嘅臉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看著我的臉。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: What horrible fancy’s this?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢可怕嘅念頭?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼可怕的念頭?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: [To Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [對愛米利亞。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對愛米利亞。]

passages.original: Some of your function, mistress, Leave procreants alone, and shut the door.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,做你嗰一行該做嘅事,讓交歡嘅人獨處,關上門。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,做你那一行該做的事,讓交歡的人獨處,關上門。

passages.original: Cough, or cry hem, if anybody come.
passages.vernacular: 有人嚟就咳嗽或喊一聲「哼」。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有人來就咳嗽或喊一聲「哼」。

passages.original: Your mystery, your mystery.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅行當,你嘅行當。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的行當,你的行當。

passages.original: Nay, dispatch.
passages.vernacular: 快去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 快去。

passages.original: [Exit Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞下。]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Upon my knees, what doth your speech import?
passages.vernacular: 我跪喺你面前,你嘅話係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我跪在你面前,你的話是什麼意思?

passages.original: I understand a fury in your words, But not the words.
passages.vernacular: 我聽出你話中嘅狂怒,卻不明白話語。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我聽出你話中的狂怒,卻不明白話語。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Why, what art thou?
passages.vernacular: 咦,你係乜嘢人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,你是什麼人?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Your wife, my lord, your true and loyal wife.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅妻子,大人,你真誠忠實嘅妻子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的妻子,大人,你真誠忠實的妻子。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Come, swear it, damn thyself, Lest, being like one of heaven, the devils themselves Should fear to seize thee.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,發誓吧,詛咒你自己,免得你像天上嘅人一樣,連魔鬼都唔敢抓你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,發誓吧,詛咒你自己,免得你像天上的人一樣,連魔鬼都不敢抓你。

passages.original: Therefore be double-damn’d.
passages.vernacular: 所以要加倍受詛咒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以要加倍受詛咒。

passages.original: Swear thou art honest.
passages.vernacular: 發誓你貞潔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 發誓你貞潔。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Heaven doth truly know it.
passages.vernacular: 上天確實知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天確實知道。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Heaven truly knows that thou art false as hell.
passages.vernacular: 上天確實知道你像地獄一樣虛偽。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天確實知道你像地獄一樣虛偽。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: To whom, my lord? With whom?
passages.vernacular: 對邊個,大人?跟邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對誰,大人?跟誰?

passages.original: How am I false?
passages.vernacular: 我點虛偽?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我怎麼虛偽?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O Desdemona, away! away! away!
passages.vernacular: 啊戴絲德夢娜,走開!走開!走開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊戴絲德夢娜,走開!走開!走開!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas the heavy day, why do you weep?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,沉重嘅日子,你點解哭?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,沉重的日子,你為什麼哭?

passages.original: Am I the motive of these tears, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人,我係呢啲眼淚嘅緣由嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人,我是這些眼淚的緣由嗎?

passages.original: If haply you my father do suspect An instrument of this your calling back, Lay not your blame on me.
passages.vernacular: 如果您或許懷疑我父親係召您回國嘅工具,請唔好把責任推到我身上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果您或許懷疑我父親是召您回國的工具,請不要把責任推到我身上。

passages.original: If you have lost him, Why, I have lost him too.
passages.vernacular: 如果您失去咗佢,咦,我都失去咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果您失去了他,咦,我也失去了他。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Had it pleas’d heaven To try me with affliction, had they rain’d All kinds of sores and shames on my bare head, Steep’d me in poverty to the very lips, Given to captivity me and my utmost hopes, I should have found in some place of my soul A drop of patience.
passages.vernacular: 如果上天高興用苦難考驗我,把各種瘡痍同恥辱降喺我光禿禿嘅頭上,讓我貧窮到浸冇嘴唇,把我同我最大嘅希望都交畀囚禁,我都能喺我靈魂嘅某處找到一滴耐心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果上天高興用苦難考驗我,把各種瘡痍和恥辱降在我光禿禿的頭上,讓我貧窮到浸沒嘴唇,把我和我最大的希望都交給囚禁,我也能在我靈魂的某處找到一滴耐心。

passages.original: But, alas, to make me A fixed figure for the time of scorn To point his slow unmoving finger at.
passages.vernacular: 但係,哎呀,要把我變成時代嘲笑嘅固定靶子,讓佢用遲緩不動嘅手指指點。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但是,哎呀,要把我變成時代嘲笑的固定靶子,讓它用遲緩不動的手指指點。

passages.original: Yet could I bear that too, well, very well: But there, where I have garner’d up my heart, Where either I must live or bear no life, The fountain from the which my current runs, Or else dries up, to be discarded thence, Or keep it as a cistern for foul toads To knot and gender in!—turn thy complexion there, Patience, thou young and rose-lipp’d cherubin, Ay, there, look grim as hell!
passages.vernacular: 然而我都能承受呢個,好好,好好:但喺嗰度,我曾把心儲藏嘅地方,我必須喺嗰度生活或唔再有生命,我嘅水流所從出嘅泉源,或者就此乾涸,竟要被趕出嗰度,或者讓佢成為骯髒蟾蜍交配繁殖嘅水池!——喺嗰度,耐心,你呢年輕玫瑰唇嘅小天使,都要變臉,對,喺嗰度,像地獄一樣陰沉!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而我也能承受這個,很好,非常好:但在那裡,我曾把心儲藏的地方,我必須在那裡生活或不再有生命,我的水流所從出的泉源,或者就此乾涸,竟要被趕出那裡,或者讓它成為骯髒蟾蜍交配繁殖的水池!——在那裡,耐心,你這年輕玫瑰唇的小天使,也要變臉,對,在那裡,像地獄一樣陰沉!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I hope my noble lord esteems me honest.
passages.vernacular: 我希望我高貴嘅大人認為我貞潔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我希望我高貴的大人認為我貞潔。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, ay, as summer flies are in the shambles, That quicken even with blowing.
passages.vernacular: 啊,係,就像屠宰場裡嘅夏蠅,一吹氣就生蛆。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,是,就像屠宰場裡的夏蠅,一吹氣就生蛆。

passages.original: O thou weed, Who art so lovely fair, and smell’st so sweet, That the sense aches at thee, Would thou hadst ne’er been born!
passages.vernacular: 啊你呢野草,如此可愛美麗,氣味如此甜美,令感官為你疼痛,但願你從未出生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你這野草,如此可愛美麗,氣味如此甜美,令感官為你疼痛,但願你從未出生!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas, what ignorant sin have I committed?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我犯咗乜嘢無知嘅罪?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我犯了什麼無知的罪?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Was this fair paper, this most goodly book, Made to write “whore” upon?
passages.vernacular: 呢張美麗嘅紙,呢本最美好嘅書,係為了喺上面寫「娼婦」而造嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這張美麗的紙,這本最美好的書,是為了在上面寫「娼婦」而造的嗎?

passages.original: What committed? Committed!
passages.vernacular: 犯咗乜嘢?犯喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 犯了什麼?犯了!

passages.original: O thou public commoner!
passages.vernacular: 啊你呢公共嘅妓女!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊你這公共的妓女!

passages.original: I should make very forges of my cheeks, That would to cinders burn up modesty, Did I but speak thy deeds.
passages.vernacular: 如果我講出你嘅行為,我會把我嘅臉頰燒成熔爐,把羞恥燒成灰燼。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我說出你的行為,我會把我的臉頰燒成熔爐,把羞恥燒成灰燼。

passages.original: What committed!
passages.vernacular: 犯咗乜嘢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 犯了什麼!

passages.original: Heaven stops the nose at it, and the moon winks;
passages.vernacular: 上天捂住鼻子,月亮閉上眼睛;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天捂住鼻子,月亮閉上眼睛;

passages.original: The bawdy wind, that kisses all it meets, Is hush’d within the hollow mine of earth, And will not hear it.
passages.vernacular: 嗰淫蕩嘅風,吻遍所遇嘅一切,喺大地空洞嘅礦穴裡靜默,唔願聽佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那淫蕩的風,吻遍所遇的一切,在大地空洞的礦穴裡靜默,不願聽它。

passages.original: What committed!
passages.vernacular: 犯咗乜嘢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 犯了什麼!

passages.original: Impudent strumpet!
passages.vernacular: 無恥嘅娼婦!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 無恥的娼婦!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: By heaven, you do me wrong.
passages.vernacular: 天啊,您冤枉我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,您冤枉我。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Are not you a strumpet?
passages.vernacular: 你唔係娼婦嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不是娼婦嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, as I am a Christian: If to preserve this vessel for my lord From any other foul unlawful touch Be not to be a strumpet, I am none.
passages.vernacular: 不,我以基督徒嘅身份講:如果為我丈夫保存呢個軀殼,免受任何其他骯髒不合法嘅觸碰,不算娼婦,嗰我就唔係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我以基督徒的身份說:如果為我丈夫保存這個軀殼,免受任何其他骯髒不合法的觸碰,不算娼婦,那我就不是。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: What, not a whore?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,唔係妓女?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,不是妓女?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, as I shall be sav’d.
passages.vernacular: 不,我以我將得救起誓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我以我將得救起誓。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Is’t possible?
passages.vernacular: 有可能嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有可能嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: O, heaven forgive us!
passages.vernacular: 啊,上天寬恕我哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,上天寬恕我們!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: I cry you mercy then.
passages.vernacular: 嗰我請求你原諒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那我請求你原諒。

passages.original: I took you for that cunning whore of Venice That married with Othello.—You, mistress,
passages.vernacular: 我把你當成嫁畀奧賽羅嘅嗰個威尼斯狡猾娼婦喇。——你,夫人,
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我把你當成嫁給奧賽羅的那個威尼斯狡猾娼婦了。——你,夫人,

passages.original: Enter Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: That have the office opposite to Saint Peter, And keeps the gate of hell.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅職務同聖彼得相反,睇守住地獄嘅大門。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的職務與聖彼得相反,看守著地獄的大門。

passages.original: You, you, ay, you!
passages.vernacular: 你,你,對,你!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你,你,對,你!

passages.original: We have done our course; there’s money for your pains.
passages.vernacular: 我哋嘅事辦完喇;呢個係畀你辛苦嘅錢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們的事辦完了;這是給你辛苦的錢。

passages.original: I pray you turn the key, and keep our counsel.
passages.vernacular: 請你轉動鑰匙,替我哋保密。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你轉動鑰匙,替我們保密。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, what does this gentleman conceive?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,呢位先生喺想乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,這位先生在想什麼?

passages.original: How do you, madam?
passages.vernacular: 您點樣,夫人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您怎樣,夫人?

passages.original: How do you, my good lady?
passages.vernacular: 您點樣,我嘅好夫人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您怎樣,我的好夫人?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Faith, half asleep.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,半瞓半醒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,半睡半醒。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Good madam, what’s the matter with my lord?
passages.vernacular: 好夫人,我嘅大人點喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好夫人,我的大人怎麼了?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: With who?
passages.vernacular: 邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Why, with my lord, madam.
passages.vernacular: 咦,我嘅大人,夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,我的大人,夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Who is thy lord?
passages.vernacular: 邊個係你嘅大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰是你的大人?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: He that is yours, sweet lady.
passages.vernacular: 就係您嘅大人,親愛嘅夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是您的大人,親愛的夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have none.
passages.vernacular: 我冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我沒有。

passages.original: Do not talk to me, Emilia, I cannot weep, nor answer have I none But what should go by water.
passages.vernacular: 別跟我講話,愛米利亞,我唔能夠哭,我都冇答案,只有淚水能表達。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別跟我說話,愛米利亞,我不能哭,我也沒有答案,只有淚水能表達。

passages.original: Prithee, tonight Lay on my bed my wedding sheets, remember, And call thy husband hither.
passages.vernacular: 請你,今晚喺我床上鋪我嘅結婚床單,記住,並叫你丈夫過嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,今晚在我床上鋪我的結婚床單,記住,並叫你丈夫過來。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Here’s a change indeed!
passages.vernacular: 真係變喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真是變了!

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: ’Tis meet I should be us’d so, very meet.
passages.vernacular: 我被咁樣對待係應該嘅,好應該。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我被這樣對待是應該的,非常應該。

passages.original: How have I been behav’d, that he might stick The small’st opinion on my least misuse?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅行為點樣,竟使佢對我最小嘅過錯都加以最輕微嘅懷疑?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的行為怎樣,竟使他對我最小的過錯也加以最輕微的懷疑?

passages.original: Enter Iago and Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古同愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古和愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What is your pleasure, madam?
passages.vernacular: 夫人,您有乜嘢吩咐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,您有什麼吩咐?

passages.original: How is’t with you?
passages.vernacular: 您點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您怎麼樣?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I cannot tell.
passages.vernacular: 我講不出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說不出來。

passages.original: Those that do teach young babes Do it with gentle means and easy tasks.
passages.vernacular: 嗰啲教導小孩嘅人,用溫和嘅方法同簡單嘅功課。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那些教導小孩的人,用溫和的方法和簡單的功課。

passages.original: He might have chid me so, for, in good faith, I am a child to chiding.
passages.vernacular: 佢本可以咁樣責備我,因為講真嘅,我對責備仲像個細路。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他本可以這樣責備我,因為說真的,我對責備還像個孩子。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What’s the matter, lady?
passages.vernacular: 夫人,點回事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,怎麼回事?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, Iago, my lord hath so bewhor’d her, Thrown such despite and heavy terms upon her, As true hearts cannot bear.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,伊阿古,我嘅大人把佢罵成娼婦,用咁惡毒沉重嘅話對佢,真心嘅人係無法忍受嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,伊阿古,我的大人把她罵成娼婦,用這麼惡毒沉重的話對她,真心的人是無法忍受的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Am I that name, Iago?
passages.vernacular: 我係嗰個名字嗎,伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是那個名字嗎,伊阿古?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What name, fair lady?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢名字,好夫人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼名字,好夫人?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Such as she says my lord did say I was.
passages.vernacular: 就係佢講我丈夫講我嘅嗰個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是她說我丈夫說我的那個。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: He call’d her whore: a beggar in his drink Could not have laid such terms upon his callet.
passages.vernacular: 佢叫佢娼婦:連一個飲醉嘅乞丐,都唔會咁樣對待佢嘅情婦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他叫她娼婦:連一個喝醉的乞丐,也不會這樣對待他的情婦。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why did he so?
passages.vernacular: 佢點解咁樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他為什麼這樣?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I do not know.
passages.vernacular: 我唔知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不知道。

passages.original: I am sure I am none such.
passages.vernacular: 我肯定我唔係嗰樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我肯定我不是那樣。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Do not weep, do not weep: alas the day!
passages.vernacular: 別哭,別哭:哎呀!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別哭,別哭:哎呀!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Hath she forsook so many noble matches, Her father, and her country, and her friends, To be call’d whore?
passages.vernacular: 佢捨棄咗咁多高貴嘅婚事、佢嘅父親、佢嘅國家、佢嘅朋友,就為了被叫作娼婦?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她捨棄了那麼多高貴的婚事、她的父親、她的國家、她的朋友,就為了被叫作娼婦?

passages.original: would it not make one weep?
passages.vernacular: 呢不叫人哭嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不叫人哭嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It is my wretched fortune.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我悲慘嘅命運。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我悲慘的命運。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Beshrew him for’t!
passages.vernacular: 該死嘅佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 該死的他!

passages.original: How comes this trick upon him?
passages.vernacular: 佢點會咁樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他怎麼會這樣?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Nay, heaven doth know.
passages.vernacular: 不,上天知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,上天知道。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I will be hang’d, if some eternal villain, Some busy and insinuating rogue, Some cogging, cozening slave, to get some office, Have not devis’d this slander.
passages.vernacular: 我願被吊死,如果唔係某個永遠嘅惡棍,某個忙碌又阿諛嘅流氓,某個欺詐嘅奴才,為了謀取官職,編造咗呢個誹謗。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我願被吊死,如果不是某個永遠的惡棍,某個忙碌又阿諛的流氓,某個欺詐的奴才,為了謀取官職,編造了這個誹謗。

passages.original: I’ll be hang’d else.
passages.vernacular: 否則我願被吊死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 否則我願被吊死。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Fie, there is no such man.
passages.vernacular: 呸,冇呢種人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,沒有這種人。

passages.original: It is impossible.
passages.vernacular: 呢唔可能。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不可能。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: If any such there be, heaven pardon him!
passages.vernacular: 如果有呢種人,上天寬恕佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果有這種人,上天寬恕他!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: A halter pardon him, and hell gnaw his bones!
passages.vernacular: 讓絞索寬恕佢,讓地獄啃佢嘅骨頭!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓絞索寬恕他,讓地獄啃他的骨頭!

passages.original: Why should he call her whore?
passages.vernacular: 佢點解叫佢娼婦?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他為什麼叫她娼婦?

passages.original: who keeps her company? What place? what time? what form?
passages.vernacular: 邊個同佢作伴?喺邊度?乜嘢時候?乜嘢形式?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰與她作伴?在哪裡?什麼時候?什麼形式?

passages.original: what likelihood?
passages.vernacular: 有乜嘢可能?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有什麼可能?

passages.original: The Moor’s abused by some most villainous knave, Some base notorious knave, some scurvy fellow.
passages.vernacular: 摩爾人被某個最卑鄙嘅惡棍欺騙喇,某個惡名昭彰嘅卑鄙人,某個下流傢伙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 摩爾人被某個最卑鄙的惡棍欺騙了,某個惡名昭彰的卑鄙人,某個下流傢伙。

passages.original: O heaven, that such companions thou’dst unfold, And put in every honest hand a whip To lash the rascals naked through the world Even from the east to the west!
passages.vernacular: 啊上天,但願你揭露呢啲人,喺每個誠實人手裡放一條鞭子,把呢啲無賴赤身抽遍全世界,從東到西!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊上天,但願你揭露這些人,在每個誠實人手裡放一條鞭子,把這些無賴赤身抽遍全世界,從東到西!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Speak within door.
passages.vernacular: 小聲講,唔好畀外面聽見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 小聲說,別讓外面聽見。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: O, fie upon them!
passages.vernacular: 啊,呸佢哋!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,呸他們!

passages.original: Some such squire he was That turn’d your wit the seamy side without, And made you to suspect me with the Moor.
passages.vernacular: 佢就係咁樣一個傢伙,把你嘅頭腦翻咗面,令你懷疑我同摩爾人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他就是這樣一個傢伙,把你的頭腦翻了面,令你懷疑我與摩爾人。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: You are a fool. Go to.
passages.vernacular: 你係個傻瓜。得喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是個傻瓜。得了。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Alas, Iago, What shall I do to win my lord again?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,伊阿古,我該點做才能重新贏回我嘅大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,伊阿古,我該怎麼做才能重新贏回我的大人?

passages.original: Good friend, go to him.
passages.vernacular: 好朋友,去找佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好朋友,去找他。

passages.original: For by this light of heaven, I know not how I lost him.
passages.vernacular: 因為憑呢天上嘅光,我唔知道我係點失去佢嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為憑這天上的光,我不知道我是怎麼失去他的。

passages.original: Here I kneel.
passages.vernacular: 我喺呢度跪下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在這裡跪下。

passages.original: If e’er my will did trespass ’gainst his love, Either in discourse of thought or actual deed, Or that mine eyes, mine ears, or any sense, Delighted them in any other form, Or that I do not yet, and ever did, And ever will, (though he do shake me off To beggarly divorcement) love him dearly, Comfort forswear me!
passages.vernacular: 如果我嘅意願曾喺言語或行動上冒犯佢嘅愛,或者我嘅眼睛、耳朵或任何感官,曾喺其他形象上取樂,或者我而家不、過去一向不、將來都永遠不(即使佢把我趕入乞丐般嘅離婚)深愛佢,願安慰離棄我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我的意願曾在言語或行動上冒犯他的愛,或者我的眼睛、耳朵或任何感官,曾在其他形象上取樂,或者我現在不、過去一向不、將來也永遠不(即使他把我趕入乞丐般的離婚)深愛他,願安慰離棄我!

passages.original: Unkindness may do much; And his unkindness may defeat my life, But never taint my love.
passages.vernacular: 無情可以做好多事;佢嘅無情可以毀掉我嘅生命,卻永遠唔能夠玷污我嘅愛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 無情可以做很多事;他的無情可以毀掉我的生命,卻永遠不能玷污我的愛。

passages.original: I cannot say “whore,” It does abhor me now I speak the word;
passages.vernacular: 我講不出「娼婦」,我講呢個詞,佢就令我厭惡;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說不出「娼婦」,我說這個詞,它就令我厭惡;

passages.original: To do the act that might the addition earn Not the world’s mass of vanity could make me.
passages.vernacular: 為了做可能贏得呢個稱號嘅事,整個世界嘅虛榮都唔能夠引誘我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為了做可能贏得這個稱號的事,整個世界的虛榮都不能引誘我。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I pray you, be content.
passages.vernacular: 請你安心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你安心。

passages.original: ’Tis but his humour.
passages.vernacular: 呢只係佢嘅脾氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這只是他的脾氣。

passages.original: The business of the state does him offence, And he does chide with you.
passages.vernacular: 國家事務使佢不快,佢就對你發脾氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 國家事務使他不快,他就對你發脾氣。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: If ’twere no other,—
passages.vernacular: 如果冇別嘅——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果沒有別的——

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: ’Tis but so, I warrant.
passages.vernacular: 肯定只係咁樣,我擔保。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯定只是這樣,我擔保。

passages.original: [Trumpets within.]
passages.vernacular: [內有號角聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有號角聲。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Hark, how these instruments summon to supper.
passages.vernacular: 聽,呢啲樂器喺召喚食晚飯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽,這些樂器在召喚吃晚飯。

passages.original: The messengers of Venice stay the meat.
passages.vernacular: 威尼斯嘅使者喺等候用餐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 威尼斯的使者在等候用餐。

passages.original: Go in, and weep not.
passages.vernacular: 進去吧,別哭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 進去吧,別哭。

passages.original: All things shall be well.
passages.vernacular: 一切都會好起嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一切都會好起來。

passages.original: [Exeunt Desdemona and Emilia.]
passages.vernacular: [戴絲德夢娜同愛米利亞下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [戴絲德夢娜和愛米利亞下。]

passages.original: Enter Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: [羅德利哥上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅德利哥上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How now, Roderigo?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,羅德利哥?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼樣,羅德利哥?

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I do not find that thou dealest justly with me.
passages.vernacular: 我發現你對我並不公平。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我發現你對我並不公平。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What in the contrary?
passages.vernacular: 有乜嘢不公平?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有什麼不公平?

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Every day thou daffest me with some device, Iago, and rather, as it seems to me now, keepest from me all conveniency than suppliest me with the least advantage of hope.
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古,你每天用某種花招搪塞我,而且而家睇來,同其講畀我啲希望嘅好處,不如講一直阻止我所有嘅便利。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古,你每天用某種花招搪塞我,而且現在看來,與其說給我一點希望的好處,不如說一直阻止我所有的便利。

passages.original: I will indeed no longer endure it.
passages.vernacular: 我真嘅唔能夠再忍受喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我真的不能再忍受了。

passages.original: Nor am I yet persuaded to put up in peace what already I have foolishly suffered.
passages.vernacular: 我都仲冇被講服,把我已經愚蠢地受過嘅就咁忍氣吞聲地算喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也還沒被說服,把我已經愚蠢地受過的就這麼忍氣吞聲地算了。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Will you hear me, Roderigo?
passages.vernacular: 你肯聽我講嗎,羅德利哥?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你肯聽我說嗎,羅德利哥?

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Faith, I have heard too much, for your words and performances are no kin together.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我聽得太多喇,因為你嘅話同你嘅行動毫不相干。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我聽得太多了,因為你的話和你的行動毫不相干。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: You charge me most unjustly.
passages.vernacular: 你咁樣指責我太不公平。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你這樣指責我太不公平。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: With naught but truth.
passages.vernacular: 我只講實話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我只說實話。

passages.original: I have wasted myself out of my means.
passages.vernacular: 我已經把自己嘅財產耗盡喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已經把自己的財產耗盡了。

passages.original: The jewels you have had from me to deliver to Desdemona would half have corrupted a votarist:
passages.vernacular: 你攞去交畀戴絲德夢娜嘅珠寶,足以收買半個修女:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你拿去交給戴絲德夢娜的珠寶,足以收買半個修女:

passages.original: you have told me she hath received them, and returned me expectations and comforts of sudden respect and acquaintance, but I find none.
passages.vernacular: 你告訴我佢收下喇,並回畀我即將受到尊重同結識嘅期待同安慰,不過我啲都冇得到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你告訴我她收下了,並回給我即將受到尊重和結識的期待與安慰,可是我一點也沒得到。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Well, go to, very well.
passages.vernacular: 好,得喇,好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,得了,很好。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Very well, go to, I cannot go to, man, nor ’tis not very well.
passages.vernacular: 好好,得喇,我可得不喇,老兄,都並不好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很好,得了,我可得不了,老兄,也並不很好。

passages.original: Nay, I say ’tis very scurvy, and begin to find myself fopped in it.
passages.vernacular: 不,我講呢好卑劣,我開始發現自己被愚弄喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我說這很卑劣,我開始發現自己被愚弄了。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Very well.
passages.vernacular: 好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 很好。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I tell you ’tis not very well.
passages.vernacular: 我告訴你呢不好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我告訴你這不好。

passages.original: I will make myself known to Desdemona.
passages.vernacular: 我要向戴絲德夢娜表明身份。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要向戴絲德夢娜表明身份。

passages.original: If she will return me my jewels, I will give over my suit and repent my unlawful solicitation.
passages.vernacular: 如果佢把我嘅珠寶還畀我,我就放棄追求,並為我不當嘅求愛懺悔。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果她把我的珠寶還給我,我就放棄追求,並為我不當的求愛懺悔。

passages.original: If not, assure yourself I will seek satisfaction of you.
passages.vernacular: 如果不,你放心,我會向你討回公道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果不,你放心,我會向你討回公道。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: You have said now.
passages.vernacular: 你講完咗吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說完了吧。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Ay, and said nothing but what I protest intendment of doing.
passages.vernacular: 係,而且我講嘅都係我聲明打算去做嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,而且我說的都是我聲明打算去做的。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why, now I see there’s mettle in thee, and even from this instant do build on thee a better opinion than ever before.
passages.vernacular: 咦,而家我睇到你有膽量,從此刻起,我對你嘅睇法比以往任何時候都更好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,現在我看到你有膽量,從此刻起,我對你的看法比以往任何時候都更好。

passages.original: Give me thy hand, Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: 把你嘅手畀我,羅德利哥。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把你的手給我,羅德利哥。

passages.original: Thou hast taken against me a most just exception, but yet I protest, I have dealt most directly in thy affair.
passages.vernacular: 你對我提出咗最公正嘅異議,不過我聲明,我喺你嘅事情上辦得最直接。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你對我提出了最公正的異議,不過我聲明,我在你的事情上辦得最直接。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: It hath not appeared.
passages.vernacular: 呢並冇顯現出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這並沒有顯現出來。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I grant indeed it hath not appeared, and your suspicion is not without wit and judgement.
passages.vernacular: 我確實承認冇顯現出嚟,你嘅懷疑並非冇智慧同判斷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我確實承認沒有顯現出來,你的懷疑並非沒有智慧和判斷。

passages.original: But, Roderigo, if thou hast that in thee indeed, which I have greater reason to believe now than ever,—I mean purpose, courage, and valour,—this night show it.
passages.vernacular: 不過,羅德利哥,如果你身上確實有我而家比以往更有理由相信嘅嗰種嘢——我指嘅係決心、膽量同勇氣——今晚就顯示出嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不過,羅德利哥,如果你身上確實有我現在比以往更有理由相信的那種東西——我指的是決心、膽量和勇氣——今晚就顯示出來。

passages.original: If thou the next night following enjoy not Desdemona, take me from this world with treachery and devise engines for my life.
passages.vernacular: 如果你第二天夜裡仲冇享受到戴絲德夢娜,就用背叛把我從呢世界上除去,並設計機關要我嘅命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你第二天夜裡還沒有享受到戴絲德夢娜,就用背叛把我從這世界上除去,並設計機關要我的命。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Well, what is it?
passages.vernacular: 好,係乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,是什麼?

passages.original: Is it within reason and compass?
passages.vernacular: 呢喺情理同範圍之內嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這在情理和範圍之內嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Sir, there is especial commission come from Venice to depute Cassio in Othello’s place.
passages.vernacular: 先生,威尼斯有特別命令送嚟,要派凱西奧接替奧賽羅嘅位置。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,威尼斯有特別命令送來,要派凱西奧接替奧賽羅的位置。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Is that true?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係真嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是真的嗎?

passages.original: Why then Othello and Desdemona return again to Venice.
passages.vernacular: 咁奧賽羅同戴絲德夢娜會回威尼斯嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼奧賽羅和戴絲德夢娜會回威尼斯嗎?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, no; he goes into Mauritania, and takes away with him the fair Desdemona, unless his abode be lingered here by some accident:
passages.vernacular: 啊,不;佢要去毛里塔尼亞,並帶走美麗嘅戴絲德夢娜,除非佢嘅逗留被某個意外耽擱喺呢度:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,不;他要去毛里塔尼亞,並帶走美麗的戴絲德夢娜,除非他的逗留被某個意外耽擱在這裡:

passages.original: wherein none can be so determinate as the removing of Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 而其中冇邊個比移除凱西奧更確定嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而其中沒有哪個比移除凱西奧更確定的。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: How do you mean “removing” of him?
passages.vernacular: 你講「移除」佢係乜嘢意思?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說「移除」他是什麼意思?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Why, by making him uncapable of Othello’s place: knocking out his brains.
passages.vernacular: 就係使佢無法接任奧賽羅嘅位置:打碎佢嘅腦袋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就是使他無法接任奧賽羅的位置:打碎他的腦袋。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: And that you would have me to do?
passages.vernacular: 你要我做呢個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要我做這個?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Ay, if you dare do yourself a profit and a right.
passages.vernacular: 係,如果你敢為自己謀利益、爭權利。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,如果你敢為自己謀利益、爭權利。

passages.original: He sups tonight with a harlotry, and thither will I go to him.
passages.vernacular: 佢今晚同一個蕩婦食晚飯,我會去嗰度找佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他今晚與一個蕩婦吃晚飯,我會去那裡找他。

passages.original: He knows not yet of his honourable fortune.
passages.vernacular: 佢仲唔知道佢嘅光榮命運。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他還不知道他的光榮命運。

passages.original: If you will watch his going thence, which I will fashion to fall out between twelve and one, you may take him at your pleasure:
passages.vernacular: 如果你觀察佢離開嗰度,我會安排喺十二點到啲之間,你可以隨意對佢下手:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你觀察他離開那裡,我會安排在十二點到一點之間,你可以隨意對他下手:

passages.original: I will be near to second your attempt, and he shall fall between us.
passages.vernacular: 我會喺附近支援你嘅行動,佢會倒喺我哋兩人之間。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會在附近支援你的行動,他會倒在我們兩人之間。

passages.original: Come, stand not amazed at it, but go along with me.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,別愣住,跟我嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,別愣著,跟我來。

passages.original: I will show you such a necessity in his death that you shall think yourself bound to put it on him.
passages.vernacular: 我會向你講明佢嘅死如何必要,使你覺得自己有責任動手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會向你說明他的死如何必要,使你覺得自己有責任動手。

passages.original: It is now high supper-time, and the night grows to waste. About it.
passages.vernacular: 而家正是晚飯時間,夜晚喺流逝。動手吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在正是晚飯時間,夜晚在流逝。動手吧。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I will hear further reason for this.
passages.vernacular: 我要再聽聽呢件事嘅更多理由。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要再聽聽這件事的更多理由。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: And you shall be satisfied.
passages.vernacular: 你會得到滿足嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會得到滿足的。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene III — Cyprus. Another Room in the Castle 第四幕第三場:塞浦路斯城堡另一室

passages.original: Enter Othello, Lodovico, Desdemona, Emilia and Attendants.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅、洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞同侍從哋上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅、洛多維科、戴絲德夢娜、愛米利亞和侍從們上。]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: I do beseech you, sir, trouble yourself no further.
passages.vernacular: 我懇求您,先生,唔好再勞駕喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我懇求您,先生,不要再勞駕了。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: O, pardon me; ’twill do me good to walk.
passages.vernacular: 啊,請原諒;散步對我有好處。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,請原諒;散步對我有好處。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Madam, good night.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,晚安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,晚安。

passages.original: I humbly thank your ladyship.
passages.vernacular: 我謙卑地感謝夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我謙卑地感謝夫人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Your honour is most welcome.
passages.vernacular: 閣下,歡迎之至。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 閣下,歡迎之至。

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Will you walk, sir?— O, Desdemona,—
passages.vernacular: 您願意散步嗎,先生?——啊,戴絲德夢娜——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您願意散步嗎,先生?——啊,戴絲德夢娜——

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My lord?
passages.vernacular: 大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大人?

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: Get you to bed on th’ instant, I will be return’d forthwith.
passages.vernacular: 即刻去瞓覺,我即刻回嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 立刻去睡覺,我馬上回來。

passages.original: Dismiss your attendant there.
passages.vernacular: 打發走你嗰度嘅侍女。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 打發走你那裡的侍女。

passages.original: Look ’t be done.
passages.vernacular: 務必照辦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 務必照辦。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I will, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 我會,大人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會,大人。

passages.original: [Exeunt Othello, Lodovico and Attendants.]
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅、洛多維科同侍從哋下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅、洛多維科和侍從們下。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: How goes it now?
passages.vernacular: 而家點樣?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在怎麼樣?

passages.original: He looks gentler than he did.
passages.vernacular: 佢睇起嚟比頭先溫和喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他看起來比剛才溫和了。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: He says he will return incontinent, He hath commanded me to go to bed, And bade me to dismiss you.
passages.vernacular: 佢講佢好快就回嚟,佢命令我去瞓覺,並吩咐我打發你走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說他很快就回來,他命令我去睡覺,並吩咐我打發你走。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Dismiss me?
passages.vernacular: 打發我走?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 打發我走?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: It was his bidding.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係佢嘅吩咐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是他的吩咐。

passages.original: Therefore, good Emilia, Give me my nightly wearing, and adieu.
passages.vernacular: 所以,好愛米利亞,把我嘅瞓衣畀我,再見。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以,好愛米利亞,把我的睡衣給我,再見。

passages.original: We must not now displease him.
passages.vernacular: 我哋而家唔能夠惹佢不高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們現在不能惹他不高興。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I would you had never seen him!
passages.vernacular: 但願你從未見過佢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願你從未見過他!

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: So would not I.
passages.vernacular: 我唔願意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不願意。

passages.original: My love doth so approve him, That even his stubbornness, his checks, his frowns,— Prithee, unpin me,—have grace and favour in them.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅愛如此認可佢,連佢嘅固執、佢嘅責備、佢嘅皺眉——請你替我解開別針——都都帶住優雅同恩惠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的愛如此認可他,連他的固執、他的責備、他的皺眉——請你替我解開別針——也都帶著優雅與恩惠。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I have laid those sheets you bade me on the bed.
passages.vernacular: 我已把你吩咐嘅嗰啲床單鋪喺床上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已把你吩咐的那些床單鋪在床上。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: All’s one.
passages.vernacular: 都一樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 都一樣。

passages.original: Good faith, how foolish are our minds!
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我哋嘅心幾咁愚蠢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我們的心多麼愚蠢!

passages.original: If I do die before thee, prithee, shroud me In one of those same sheets.
passages.vernacular: 如果我比你先死,請你用嗰啲床單中嘅一條裹我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我比你先死,請你用那些床單中的一條裹我。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Come, come, you talk.
passages.vernacular: 得喇,得喇,你講些乜嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 得了,得了,你說些什麼。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: My mother had a maid call’d Barbary, She was in love, and he she lov’d prov’d mad And did forsake her.
passages.vernacular: 我母親有個侍女叫芭芭莉,佢戀愛喇,佢愛嘅人變心發瘋,離棄咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我母親有個侍女叫芭芭莉,她戀愛了,她愛的人變心發瘋,離棄了她。

passages.original: She had a song of “willow”, An old thing ’twas, but it express’d her fortune, And she died singing it.
passages.vernacular: 佢有一首「柳樹」嘅歌,係首古老嘅歌,但表達咗佢嘅命運,佢唱住佢死去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她有一首「柳樹」的歌,是首古老的歌,但表達了她的命運,她唱著它死去。

passages.original: That song tonight Will not go from my mind.
passages.vernacular: 今晚嗰首歌從我心裡揮之不去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 今晚那首歌從我心裡揮之不去。

passages.original: I have much to do But to go hang my head all at one side And sing it like poor Barbary.
passages.vernacular: 我簡直忍不住要把頭歪向一邊,像可憐嘅芭芭莉嗰樣唱佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我簡直忍不住要把頭歪向一邊,像可憐的芭芭莉那樣唱它。

passages.original: Prithee dispatch.
passages.vernacular: 請你快點。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你快點。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Shall I go fetch your night-gown?
passages.vernacular: 要我去攞你嘅瞓袍嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要我去拿你的睡袍嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, unpin me here.
passages.vernacular: 不,喺呢度幫我解開別針。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,在這裡幫我解開別針。

passages.original: This Lodovico is a proper man.
passages.vernacular: 呢個洛多維科係個俊俏嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個洛多維科是個俊俏的人。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: A very handsome man.
passages.vernacular: 好英俊嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常英俊的人。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: He speaks well.
passages.vernacular: 佢講話得體。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他說話得體。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: I know a lady in Venice would have walked barefoot to Palestine for a touch of his nether lip.
passages.vernacular: 我知道威尼斯有位夫人,為了碰一下佢嘅下唇,願意赤腳走到巴勒斯坦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我知道威尼斯有位夫人,為了碰一下他的下唇,願意赤腳走到巴勒斯坦。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: [Singing.]
The poor soul sat sighing by a sycamore tree, Sing all a green willow.
passages.vernacular: 可憐嘅人兒坐喺無花果樹旁歎息,唱啊,一片綠柳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 可憐的人兒坐在無花果樹旁歎息,唱啊,一片綠柳。

passages.original: Her hand on her bosom, her head on her knee, Sing willow, willow, willow.
passages.vernacular: 佢手放胸前,頭靠膝上,唱柳,柳,柳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她手放胸前,頭靠膝上,唱柳,柳,柳。

passages.original: The fresh streams ran by her, and murmur’d her moans, Sing willow, willow, willow;
passages.vernacular: 清清嘅溪流從佢身旁流過,應同佢嘅哀歎,唱柳,柳,柳;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 清清的溪流從她身旁流過,應和她的哀歎,唱柳,柳,柳;

passages.original: Her salt tears fell from her, and soften’d the stones;—
passages.vernacular: 佢鹹鹹嘅眼淚落下,軟化咗石頭;——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她鹹鹹的眼淚落下,軟化了石頭;——

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Lay by these:—
passages.vernacular: 把呢啲收起:——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把這些收起:——

passages.original: [Sings.] Sing willow, willow, willow.
passages.vernacular: [唱。]唱柳,柳,柳。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]唱柳,柳,柳。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Prithee hie thee.
passages.vernacular: 請你快點。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你快點。

passages.original: He’ll come anon.
passages.vernacular: 佢即刻就嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他馬上就來。

passages.original: [Sings.] Sing all a green willow must be my garland. Let nobody blame him, his scorn I approve,—
passages.vernacular: [唱。]唱啊,一片綠柳必係我嘅花環。邊個都唔好怪佢,佢嘅輕蔑我認可——
passages.vernacularMandarin: [唱。]唱啊,一片綠柳必是我的花環。誰也不要怪他,他的輕蔑我認可——

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Nay, that’s not next. Hark!
passages.vernacular: 不,下面唔係呢句。聽!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,下面不是這句。聽!

passages.original: who is’t that knocks?
passages.vernacular: 邊個喺敲門?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在敲門?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: It’s the wind.
passages.vernacular: 係風。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是風。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: [Sings.]
I call’d my love false love; but what said he then?
passages.vernacular: 我叫我嘅愛人負心人;佢點回答?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我叫我的愛人負心人;他怎麼回答?

passages.original: Sing willow, willow, willow: If I court mo women, you’ll couch with mo men.
passages.vernacular: 唱柳,柳,柳:如果我追求更多女人,你就同更多男人同瞓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 唱柳,柳,柳:如果我追求更多女人,你就和更多男人同睡。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: So get thee gone; good night.
passages.vernacular: 所以走吧;晚安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以走吧;晚安。

passages.original: Mine eyes do itch; Doth that bode weeping?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅眼睛發癢;呢預示要哭嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的眼睛發癢;這預示要哭嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: ’Tis neither here nor there.
passages.vernacular: 呢不好講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不好說。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I have heard it said so.
passages.vernacular: 我聽人咁樣講過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我聽人這樣說過。

passages.original: O, these men, these men!
passages.vernacular: 啊,呢啲男人,呢啲男人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,這些男人,這些男人!

passages.original: Dost thou in conscience think,—tell me, Emilia,— That there be women do abuse their husbands In such gross kind?
passages.vernacular: 憑良心講,你認為,告訴我,愛米利亞,有女人會咁樣粗劣地欺騙自己嘅丈夫嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 憑良心說,你認為,告訴我,愛米利亞,有女人會這樣粗劣地欺騙自己的丈夫嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: There be some such, no question.
passages.vernacular: 肯定有啲,毫無疑問。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 肯定有一些,毫無疑問。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Wouldst thou do such a deed for all the world?
passages.vernacular: 你會為了整個世界做呢種事嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會為了整個世界做這種事嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Why, would not you?
passages.vernacular: 咦,你唔會嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,你不會嗎?

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: No, by this heavenly light!
passages.vernacular: 不,憑呢天上嘅光!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,憑這天上的光!

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Nor I neither by this heavenly light, I might do’t as well i’ the dark.
passages.vernacular: 我都唔會,憑呢天上嘅光,我喺黑暗中都能做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不會,憑這天上的光,我在黑暗中也能做。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Wouldst thou do such a deed for all the world?
passages.vernacular: 你會為了整個世界做呢種事嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你會為了整個世界做這種事嗎?

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: The world’s a huge thing.
passages.vernacular: 世界係個巨大嘅嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 世界是個巨大的東西。

passages.original: It is a great price For a small vice.
passages.vernacular: 對一件小惡來講,呢個係個好大嘅代價。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對一件小惡來說,這是個很大的代價。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: In troth, I think thou wouldst not.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我想你唔會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我想你不會。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: In troth, I think I should, and undo’t when I had done.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,我想我會,做完再把佢抹去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,我想我會,做完再把它抹去。

passages.original: Marry, I would not do such a thing for a joint-ring, nor for measures of lawn, nor for gowns, petticoats, nor caps, nor any petty exhibition;
passages.vernacular: 當然,我唔會為了一枚連環戒指、幾匹細麻布、袍子、襯裙或帽子,或任何小小嘅津貼做呢種事;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當然,我不會為了一枚連環戒指、幾匹細麻布、袍子、襯裙或帽子,或任何小小的津貼做這種事;

passages.original: but, for the whole world—why, who would not make her husband a cuckold to make him a monarch?
passages.vernacular: 但為了整個世界——咦,邊個唔願意畀丈夫戴綠帽,換佢做君王?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但為了整個世界——咦,誰不願意給丈夫戴綠帽,換他做君王?

passages.original: I should venture purgatory for ’t.
passages.vernacular: 我願冒煉獄之險。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我願冒煉獄之險。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Beshrew me, if I would do such a wrong for the whole world.
passages.vernacular: 我若為了整個世界做呢種錯事,真該死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我若為了整個世界做這種錯事,真該死。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Why, the wrong is but a wrong i’ the world; and having the world for your labour, ’tis a wrong in your own world, and you might quickly make it right.
passages.vernacular: 咦,呢種錯喺呢世界上不過係一種錯;既然得到整個世界作為報酬,佢就係你自己世界裡嘅錯,你可以好快把佢變成對嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,這種錯在這世界上不過是一種錯;既然得到整個世界作為報酬,它就是你自己世界裡的錯,你可以很快把它變成對的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: I do not think there is any such woman.
passages.vernacular: 我不認為有咁樣嘅女人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不認為有這樣的女人。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Yes, a dozen; and as many to the vantage as would store the world they played for.
passages.vernacular: 有,有十幾打;而且多到足以充滿佢哋所賭嘅世界。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有,有十幾打;而且多到足以充滿她們所賭的世界。

passages.original: But I do think it is their husbands’ faults If wives do fall:
passages.vernacular: 但我確實認為,如果妻子墮落,係丈夫嘅過錯:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但我確實認為,如果妻子墮落,是丈夫的過錯:

passages.original: say that they slack their duties, And pour our treasures into foreign laps;
passages.vernacular: 比如講佢哋疏忽咗責任,把我哋嘅財寶倒進外人嘅懷裡;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 比如說他們疏忽了責任,把我們的財寶倒進外人的懷裡;

passages.original: Or else break out in peevish jealousies, Throwing restraint upon us.
passages.vernacular: 或者爆發出古怪嘅嫉妒,對我哋加以限制。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 或者爆發出古怪的嫉妒,對我們加以限制。

passages.original: Or say they strike us, Or scant our former having in despite.
passages.vernacular: 或者講佢哋打我哋,或惡意地削減我哋原有嘅嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 或者說他們打我們,或惡意地削減我們原有的東西。

passages.original: Why, we have galls; and though we have some grace, Yet have we some revenge.
passages.vernacular: 咦,我哋都有脾氣;雖然我哋有些德行,但都有些報復心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 咦,我們也有脾氣;雖然我們有些德行,但也有些報復心。

passages.original: Let husbands know Their wives have sense like them:
passages.vernacular: 讓丈夫哋知道佢哋嘅妻子同佢哋一樣有感覺:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓丈夫們知道他們的妻子和他們一樣有感覺:

passages.original: they see, and smell And have their palates both for sweet and sour, As husbands have.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋睇得見,聞得到,都有分辨甜酸嘅味覺,同丈夫一樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她們看得見,聞得到,也有分辨甜酸的味覺,和丈夫一樣。

passages.original: What is it that they do When they change us for others?
passages.vernacular: 佢哋用別嘅女人換掉我哋時,係喺做乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們用別的女人換掉我們時,是在做什麼?

passages.original: Is it sport?
passages.vernacular: 係消遣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是消遣嗎?

passages.original: I think it is.
passages.vernacular: 我想係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想是。

passages.original: And doth affection breed it?
passages.vernacular: 係感情引起嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是感情引起的嗎?

passages.original: I think it doth.
passages.vernacular: 我想係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想是。

passages.original: Is’t frailty that thus errs?
passages.vernacular: 係軟弱導致咁樣嘅錯嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是軟弱導致這樣的錯嗎?

passages.original: It is so too.
passages.vernacular: 都係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也是。

passages.original: And have not we affections, Desires for sport, and frailty, as men have?
passages.vernacular: 難道我哋冇感情、貪玩嘅慾望同軟弱,像男人一樣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 難道我們沒有感情、貪玩的慾望和軟弱,像男人一樣嗎?

passages.original: Then let them use us well: else let them know, The ills we do, their ills instruct us so.
passages.vernacular: 嗰就讓佢哋好好對待我哋:否則讓佢哋知道,我哋做嘅壞事,係佢哋嘅壞事教我哋嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那就讓他們好好對待我們:否則讓他們知道,我們做的壞事,是他們的壞事教我們的。

passages.title: Desdemona 戴絲德夢娜
passages.original: Good night, good night.
passages.vernacular: 晚安,晚安。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 晚安,晚安。

passages.original: Heaven me such usage send, Not to pick bad from bad, but by bad mend!
passages.vernacular: 願上天賜我咁樣嘅待遇:唔係從壞中選壞,而係借壞變好!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願上天賜我這樣的待遇:不是從壞中選壞,而是借壞變好!

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act V, Scene I — Cyprus. A Street 第五幕第一場:塞浦路斯街道

passages.original: Enter Iago and Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古同羅德利哥上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古和羅德利哥上。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Here, stand behind this bulk.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,站喺呢個大塊頭後面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,站在這個大塊頭後面。

passages.original: Straight will he come.
passages.vernacular: 佢即刻就嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他馬上就來。

passages.original: Wear thy good rapier bare, and put it home.
passages.vernacular: 拔出你嘅好細劍,插進去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拔出你的好細劍,插進去。

passages.original: Quick, quick, fear nothing; I’ll be at thy elbow.
passages.vernacular: 快,快,別怕;我就喺你身邊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 快,快,別怕;我就在你身邊。

passages.original: It makes us, or it mars us, think on that, And fix most firm thy resolution.
passages.vernacular: 呢決定我哋成敗,想想呢點,堅定你嘅決心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這決定我們成敗,想想這點,堅定你的決心。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Be near at hand, I may miscarry in ’t.
passages.vernacular: 靠近我,我可能失手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 靠近我,我可能失手。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Here, at thy hand.
passages.vernacular: 喺呢度,喺你手邊。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這裡,在你手邊。

passages.original: Be bold, and take thy stand.
passages.vernacular: 大膽些,站好位置。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大膽些,站好位置。

passages.original: [Retires to a little distance.]
passages.vernacular: [退到不遠處。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [退到不遠處。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I have no great devotion to the deed; And yet he hath given me satisfying reasons.
passages.vernacular: 我對呢件事並不好熱心;然而佢畀咗我令人滿意嘅理由。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我對這件事並不十分熱心;然而他給了我令人滿意的理由。

passages.original: ’Tis but a man gone.
passages.vernacular: 不過係少咗一個人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不過是少了一個人。

passages.original: Forth, my sword; he dies.
passages.vernacular: 出鞘吧,我嘅劍;佢要死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 出鞘吧,我的劍;他要死了。

passages.original: [Goes to his stand.]
passages.vernacular: [走到自己嘅位置。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [走到自己的位置。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I have rubb’d this young quat almost to the sense, And he grows angry.
passages.vernacular: 我把呢個小傢伙擦到幾乎有感覺喇,佢發怒喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我把這個小傢伙擦到幾乎有感覺了,他發怒了。

passages.original: Now, whether he kill Cassio, Or Cassio him, or each do kill the other, Every way makes my gain.
passages.vernacular: 而家,無論佢殺凱西奧,定係凱西奧殺佢,定係兩個互相殺死,點樣都對我有利。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,無論他殺凱西奧,還是凱西奧殺他,還是兩個互相殺死,怎麼樣都對我有利。

passages.original: Live Roderigo, He calls me to a restitution large Of gold and jewels that I bobb’d from him, As gifts to Desdemona.
passages.vernacular: 羅德利哥若活住,佢會要我歸還大量金子同珠寶,嗰個係我騙佢當作送畀戴絲德夢娜嘅禮物嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 羅德利哥若活著,他會要我歸還大量金子和珠寶,那是我騙他當作送給戴絲德夢娜的禮物的。

passages.original: It must not be.
passages.vernacular: 唔能夠讓咁樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不能讓這樣。

passages.original: If Cassio do remain, He hath a daily beauty in his life That makes me ugly.
passages.vernacular: 如果凱西奧活住,佢生活中有一種每日嘅美,使我顯得醜陋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果凱西奧活著,他生活中有一種每日的美,使我顯得醜陋。

passages.original: And besides, the Moor May unfold me to him; there stand I in much peril.
passages.vernacular: 而且,摩爾人可能向佢揭穿我;嗰樣我就處於極大危險中。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而且,摩爾人可能向他揭穿我;那樣我就處於極大危險中。

passages.original: No, he must die.
passages.vernacular: 不,佢必須死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,他必須死。

passages.original: But so, I hear him coming.
passages.vernacular: 就咁樣,我聽到佢嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就這樣,我聽到他來了。

passages.original: Enter Cassio.
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧上。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: I know his gait; ’tis he.
passages.vernacular: 我認得佢嘅步態;係佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我認得他的步態;是他。

passages.original: Villain, thou diest!
passages.vernacular: 惡棍,你去死吧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 惡棍,你去死吧!

passages.original: [Rushes out, and makes a pass at Cassio.]
passages.vernacular: [衝出,向凱西奧刺一劍。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [衝出,向凱西奧刺一劍。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: That thrust had been mine enemy indeed, But that my coat is better than thou know’st.
passages.vernacular: 嗰一刺本來真係我嘅敵人,不過我嘅外衣比你知道嘅更好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那一刺本來真是我的敵人,不過我的外衣比你知道的更好。

passages.original: I will make proof of thine.
passages.vernacular: 我嚟試試你嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我來試試你的。

passages.original: [Draws, and wounds Roderigo.]
passages.vernacular: [拔劍,刺傷羅德利哥。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [拔劍,刺傷羅德利哥。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O, I am slain!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我被殺喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我被殺了!

passages.original: [Iago rushes from his post, cuts Cassio behind in the leg, and exit.]
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古從崗位衝出,從後面砍傷凱西奧嘅腿,然後下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古從崗位衝出,從後面砍傷凱西奧的腿,然後下。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I am maim’d forever. Help, ho!
passages.vernacular: 我永遠殘廢喇。救命,喂!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我永遠殘廢了。救命,喂!

passages.original: murder, murder!
passages.vernacular: 謀殺,謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謀殺,謀殺!

passages.original: [Falls.]
passages.vernacular: [倒下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [倒下。]

passages.original: Enter Othello.
passages.vernacular: [奧賽羅上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奧賽羅上。]

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: The voice of Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 係凱西奧嘅聲音。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是凱西奧的聲音。

passages.original: Iago keeps his word.
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古信守諾言。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古信守諾言。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O, villain that I am!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我真係個惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我真是個惡棍!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: It is even so.
passages.vernacular: 確實如此。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實如此。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: O, help, ho! light! a surgeon!
passages.vernacular: 啊,救命,喂!光!外科醫生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,救命,喂!光!外科醫生!

passages.title: Othello 奧賽羅
passages.original: ’Tis he.
passages.vernacular: 係佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是他。

passages.original: O brave Iago, honest and just, That hast such noble sense of thy friend’s wrong!
passages.vernacular: 啊勇敢嘅伊阿古,誠實而公正,對朋友所受嘅冤屈有如此高貴嘅感觸!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊勇敢的伊阿古,誠實而公正,對朋友所受的冤屈有如此高貴的感觸!

passages.original: Thou teachest me,—minion, your dear lies dead, And your unbless’d fate hies.
passages.vernacular: 你教我——寶貝,你嘅愛人死喇,你不蒙福嘅命運快嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你教我——寶貝,你的愛人死了,你不蒙福的命運快來了。

passages.original: Strumpet, I come!
passages.vernacular: 娼婦,我嚟喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 娼婦,我來了!

passages.original: Forth of my heart those charms, thine eyes, are blotted;
passages.vernacular: 你眼睛嘅魅力已從我心中抹去;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你眼睛的魅力已從我心中抹去;

passages.original: Thy bed, lust-stain’d, shall with lust’s blood be spotted.
passages.vernacular: 你沾染淫慾嘅床,將被淫慾嘅血染汙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你沾染淫慾的床,將被淫慾的血染汙。

passages.original: [Exit.]
Enter Lodovico and Gratiano.
passages.vernacular: [洛多維科同格拉希安諾上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [洛多維科和格拉希安諾上。]

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: What, ho! No watch? No passage?
passages.vernacular: 喂!冇守衛嗎?冇路人嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喂!沒有守衛嗎?沒有路人嗎?

passages.original: murder, murder!
passages.vernacular: 謀殺,謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謀殺,謀殺!

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: ’Tis some mischance; the cry is very direful.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢意外;喊聲好可怕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼意外;喊聲很可怕。

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: O, help!
passages.vernacular: 啊,救命!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,救命!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Hark!
passages.vernacular: 聽!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽!

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O wretched villain!
passages.vernacular: 啊可憐嘅惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊可憐的惡棍!

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Two or three groan.
passages.vernacular: 有兩三個人喺呻吟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有兩三個人在呻吟。

passages.original: It is a heavy night.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係個沉重嘅夜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是個沉重的夜。

passages.original: These may be counterfeits.
passages.vernacular: 呢可能係假裝嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這可能是假裝的。

passages.original: Let’s think’t unsafe To come in to the cry without more help.
passages.vernacular: 我哋別冒險,不增援就貿然走向喊聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們別冒險,不增援就貿然走向喊聲。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: Nobody come?
passages.vernacular: 冇人嚟嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒人來嗎?

passages.original: Then shall I bleed to death.
passages.vernacular: 嗰我會流血而死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那我會流血而死。

passages.original: Enter Iago with a light.
passages.vernacular: [伊阿古持燈上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [伊阿古持燈上。]

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: Hark!
passages.vernacular: 聽!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽!

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Here’s one comes in his shirt, with light and weapons.
passages.vernacular: 有個人穿住襯衫嚟喇,帶住燈同武器。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有個人穿著襯衫來了,帶著燈和武器。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Who’s there?
passages.vernacular: 邊個喺嗰度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在那裡?

passages.original: Whose noise is this that cries on murder?
passages.vernacular: 係邊個喺喊謀殺?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是誰在喊謀殺?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: We do not know.
passages.vernacular: 我哋唔知道。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們不知道。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Did not you hear a cry?
passages.vernacular: 你哋冇聽到喊聲嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們沒聽到喊聲嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Here, here!
passages.vernacular: 呢度,呢度!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡,這裡!

passages.original: for heaven’s sake, help me!
passages.vernacular: 睇喺天嘅份上,救我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看在天的份上,救我!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What’s the matter?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼事?

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: This is Othello’s ancient, as I take it.
passages.vernacular: 我想呢個係奧賽羅嘅旗官。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想這是奧賽羅的旗官。

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: The same indeed, a very valiant fellow.
passages.vernacular: 正是,一個好勇敢嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是,一個很勇敢的人。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: What are you here that cry so grievously?
passages.vernacular: 你係邊個,喺呢度咁悲慘地叫?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是誰,在這裡這麼悲慘地叫?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: Iago?
passages.vernacular: 伊阿古?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 伊阿古?

passages.original: O, I am spoil’d, undone by villains!
passages.vernacular: 啊,我被毀喇,被惡棍害喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我被毀了,被惡棍害了!

passages.original: Give me some help.
passages.vernacular: 畀我些幫助。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我些幫助。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O me, lieutenant!
passages.vernacular: 啊,副官!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,副官!

passages.original: What villains have done this?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢惡棍幹嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼惡棍幹的?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: I think that one of them is hereabout, And cannot make away.
passages.vernacular: 我想佢哋有一個喺附近,逃不掉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想他們有一個在附近,逃不掉。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O treacherous villains!
passages.vernacular: 啊,奸詐嘅惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,奸詐的惡棍!

passages.original: [To Lodovico and Gratiano.]
passages.vernacular: [對洛多維科同格拉希安諾。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對洛多維科和格拉希安諾。]

passages.original: What are you there?
passages.vernacular: 你哋係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們是誰?

passages.original: Come in and give some help.
passages.vernacular: 過嚟幫忙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 過來幫忙。

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O, help me here!
passages.vernacular: 啊,喺呢度幫我!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,在這裡幫我!

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: That’s one of them.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係佢哋中嘅一個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是他們中的一個。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O murderous slave! O villain!
passages.vernacular: 啊,殺人嘅奴才!啊,惡棍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,殺人的奴才!啊,惡棍!

passages.original: [Stabs Roderigo.]
passages.vernacular: [刺羅德利哥。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [刺羅德利哥。]

passages.title: Roderigo 羅德利哥
passages.original: O damn’d Iago!
passages.vernacular: 啊,該死嘅伊阿古!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,該死的伊阿古!

passages.original: O inhuman dog!
passages.vernacular: 啊,冇人性嘅狗!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,沒人性的狗!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Kill men i’ the dark!
passages.vernacular: 喺黑暗中殺人!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在黑暗中殺人!

passages.original: Where be these bloody thieves?
passages.vernacular: 呢啲血腥嘅賊喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些血腥的賊在哪裡?

passages.original: How silent is this town! Ho! murder! murder!
passages.vernacular: 呢座城幾咁安靜!喂!謀殺!謀殺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這座城多麼安靜!喂!謀殺!謀殺!

passages.original: What may you be?
passages.vernacular: 你哋係乜嘢人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們是什麼人?

passages.original: Are you of good or evil?
passages.vernacular: 係善係惡?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是善是惡?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: As you shall prove us, praise us.
passages.vernacular: 你哋將點樣證明我哋,就點樣稱讚我哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們將怎樣證明我們,就怎樣稱讚我們。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Signior Lodovico?
passages.vernacular: 洛多維科大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 洛多維科大人?

passages.title: Lodovico 洛多維科
passages.original: He, sir.
passages.vernacular: 係我,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是我,先生。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: I cry you mercy.
passages.vernacular: 請原諒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請原諒。

passages.original: Here’s Cassio hurt by villains.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係凱西奧被惡棍所傷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是凱西奧被惡棍所傷。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How is’t, brother?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,兄弟?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼樣,兄弟?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: My leg is cut in two.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅腿被砍成兩段。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的腿被砍成兩段。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Marry, heaven forbid!
passages.vernacular: 天啊,但願唔係!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天啊,但願不是!

passages.original: Light, gentlemen, I’ll bind it with my shirt.
passages.vernacular: 先生哋,攞燈嚟,我用我嘅襯衫包紮佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生們,拿燈來,我用我的襯衫包紮它。

passages.original: Enter Bianca.
passages.vernacular: [比安卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [比安卡上。]

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: What is the matter, ho?
passages.vernacular: 點回事,喂?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼回事,喂?

passages.original: Who is’t that cried?
passages.vernacular: 係邊個喺喊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是誰在喊?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Who is’t that cried?
passages.vernacular: 係邊個喺喊?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是誰在喊?

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: O my dear Cassio, my sweet Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 啊我親愛嘅凱西奧,我甜美嘅凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊我親愛的凱西奧,我甜美的凱西奧!

passages.original: O Cassio, Cassio, Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O notable strumpet!
passages.vernacular: 啊,出名嘅娼婦!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,出名的娼婦!

passages.original: Cassio, may you suspect Who they should be that have thus mangled you?
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧,你能懷疑係邊個把你弄成咁樣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧,你能懷疑是誰把你弄成這樣嗎?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: No.
passages.vernacular: 唔能夠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不能。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: I am sorry to find you thus; I have been to seek you.
passages.vernacular: 睇到你咁樣我好難過;我一直喺找你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看到你這樣我很難過;我一直在找你。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Lend me a garter.
passages.vernacular: 借我一條襪帶。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 借我一條襪帶。

passages.original: So.—O, for a chair, To bear him easily hence!
passages.vernacular: 好。——啊,要一張椅子,輕輕把佢抬走!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好。——啊,要一張椅子,輕輕把他抬走!

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: Alas, he faints!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,佢昏過去喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,他昏過去了!

passages.original: O Cassio, Cassio, Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊凱西奧,凱西奧,凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Gentlemen all, I do suspect this trash To be a party in this injury.
passages.vernacular: 各位先生,我懷疑呢垃圾都參與咗呢次傷害。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 各位先生,我懷疑這垃圾也參與了這次傷害。

passages.original: Patience awhile, good Cassio.
passages.vernacular: 耐心一會兒,好凱西奧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 耐心一會兒,好凱西奧。

passages.original: Come, come; Lend me a light.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,嚟;借我一盞燈。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,來;借我一盞燈。

passages.original: Know we this face or no?
passages.vernacular: 我哋認得呢張臉嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們認得這張臉嗎?

passages.original: Alas, my friend and my dear countryman Roderigo? No.
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,我嘅朋友同親愛嘅同鄉羅德利哥?不。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,我的朋友和親愛的同鄉羅德利哥?不。

passages.original: Yes, sure; O heaven! Roderigo.
passages.vernacular: 係,肯定;啊天啊!羅德利哥。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,肯定;啊天啊!羅德利哥。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: What, of Venice?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,威尼斯嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,威尼斯的?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Even he, sir.
passages.vernacular: 正是佢,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 正是他,先生。

passages.original: Did you know him?
passages.vernacular: 你認識佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你認識他?

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Know him? Ay.
passages.vernacular: 認識佢?係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 認識他?是。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Signior Gratiano?
passages.vernacular: 格拉希安諾大人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 格拉希安諾大人?

passages.original: I cry you gentle pardon.
passages.vernacular: 請原諒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請原諒。

passages.original: These bloody accidents must excuse my manners, That so neglected you.
passages.vernacular: 呢啲血腥嘅事故必須原諒我嘅失禮,竟怠慢咗您。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些血腥的事故必須原諒我的失禮,竟怠慢了您。

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: I am glad to see you.
passages.vernacular: 見到你我好高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 見到你我很高興。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: How do you, Cassio?
passages.vernacular: 你點樣,凱西奧?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你怎樣,凱西奧?

passages.original: O, a chair, a chair!
passages.vernacular: 啊,一張椅子,一張椅子!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,一張椅子,一張椅子!

passages.title: Gratiano 格拉希安諾
passages.original: Roderigo!
passages.vernacular: 羅德利哥!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 羅德利哥!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: He, he, ’tis he.
passages.vernacular: 係佢,係佢,係佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是他,是他,是他。

passages.original: [A chair brought in.]
passages.vernacular: [抬進一張椅子。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [抬進一張椅子。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, that’s well said; the chair.
passages.vernacular: 啊,講得好;椅子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,說得好;椅子。

passages.original: Some good man bear him carefully from hence, I’ll fetch the general’s surgeon.
passages.vernacular: 請邊位好心人小心地把佢抬走,我去叫將軍嘅外科醫生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請哪位好心人小心地把他抬走,我去叫將軍的外科醫生。

passages.original: [To Bianca] For you, mistress, Save you your labour.
passages.vernacular: [對比安卡]至於你,夫人,唔使白費力氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對比安卡]至於你,夫人,不用白費力氣。

passages.original: He that lies slain here, Cassio, Was my dear friend.
passages.vernacular: 躺喺呢度被殺嘅人,凱西奧,係我親愛嘅朋友。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 躺在這裡被殺的人,凱西奧,是我親愛的朋友。

passages.original: What malice was between you?
passages.vernacular: 你哋之間有乜嘢怨恨?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們之間有什麼怨恨?

passages.title: Cassio 凱西奧
passages.original: None in the world.
passages.vernacular: 世上啲都冇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 世上一點也沒有。

passages.original: Nor do I know the man.
passages.vernacular: 我都不認識呢個人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也不認識這個人。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: [To Bianca.]
passages.vernacular: [對比安卡。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對比安卡。]

passages.original: What, look you pale?—O, bear him out o’ the air.
passages.vernacular: 點,你臉色蒼白?——啊,把佢抬出去呼吸新鮮空氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼,你臉色蒼白?——啊,把他抬出去呼吸新鮮空氣。

passages.original: [Cassio and Roderigo are borne off.]
passages.vernacular: [凱西奧同羅德利哥被抬走。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [凱西奧和羅德利哥被抬走。]

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Stay you, good gentlemen.—Look you pale, mistress?
passages.vernacular: 留下,好先生哋。——夫人,你臉色蒼白?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 留下,好先生們。——夫人,你臉色蒼白?

passages.original: Do you perceive the gastness of her eye?
passages.vernacular: 你哋注意到佢眼神嘅驚恐咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們注意到她眼神的驚恐了嗎?

passages.original: Nay, if you stare, we shall hear more anon.
passages.vernacular: 不,如果你瞪眼,我哋好快就會聽到更多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,如果你瞪眼,我們很快就會聽到更多。

passages.original: Behold her well.
passages.vernacular: 好好睇佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好好看她。

passages.original: I pray you, look upon her.
passages.vernacular: 請你哋睇睇佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你們看看她。

passages.original: Do you see, gentlemen?
passages.vernacular: 你哋睇到咗嗎,先生哋?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們看到了嗎,先生們?

passages.original: Nay, guiltiness will speak Though tongues were out of use.
passages.vernacular: 不,罪疚會講話,即使舌頭唔能夠用。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,罪疚會說話,即使舌頭不能用。

passages.original: Enter Emilia.
passages.vernacular: [愛米利亞上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [愛米利亞上。]

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: ’Las, what’s the matter?
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,點回事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,怎麼回事?

passages.original: What’s the matter, husband?
passages.vernacular: 點回事,丈夫?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼回事,丈夫?

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: Cassio hath here been set on in the dark By Roderigo, and fellows that are ’scap’d.
passages.vernacular: 凱西奧喺黑暗中被羅德利哥同逃掉嘅同夥襲擊喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凱西奧在黑暗中被羅德利哥和逃掉的同夥襲擊了。

passages.original: He’s almost slain, and Roderigo dead.
passages.vernacular: 佢幾乎被殺,羅德利哥死喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他幾乎被殺,羅德利哥死了。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Alas, good gentleman!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,好先生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,好先生!

passages.original: alas, good Cassio!
passages.vernacular: 哎呀,好凱西奧!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎呀,好凱西奧!

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: This is the fruit of whoring.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係嫖娼嘅果實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是嫖娼的果實。

passages.original: Prithee, Emilia, Go know of Cassio where he supp’d tonight.
passages.vernacular: 請你,愛米利亞,去問凱西奧今晚喺邊度食晚飯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,愛米利亞,去問凱西奧今晚在哪裡吃晚飯。

passages.original: What, do you shake at that?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,你為呢個發抖?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,你為這個發抖?

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: He supp’d at my house, but I therefore shake not.
passages.vernacular: 佢喺我家食晚飯,但我並不因此發抖。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他在我家吃晚飯,但我並不因此發抖。

passages.title: Iago 伊阿古
passages.original: O, did he so?
passages.vernacular: 啊,係嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,是嗎?

passages.original: I charge you go with me.
passages.vernacular: 我命令你跟我走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我命令你跟我走。

passages.title: Emilia 愛米利亞
passages.original: Fie, fie upon thee, strumpet!
passages.vernacular: 呸,呸你,娼婦!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,呸你,娼婦!

passages.title: Bianca 比安卡
passages.original: I am no strumpet, but of life as honest As you that thus abuse me.
passages.vernacular: 我唔係娼婦,我嘅品行跟你咁樣辱罵我嘅人一樣誠實。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不是娼婦,我的品行跟你這樣辱罵我的人一樣誠實。
